";
        var REEL_POSTER = "data:image/jpeg;base64,";
        var FV_CHEV_L = '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M14.5 5.5 8 12l6.5 6.5"/></svg>';
        var FV_CHEV_R = '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9.5 5.5 16 12l-6.5 6.5"/></svg>';
        var FV_PLAY_SVG = '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M8 5.14v13.72c0 .8.87 1.3 1.56.88l10.5-6.86a1.03 1.03 0 0 0 0-1.76L9.56 4.26A1.03 1.03 0 0 0 8 5.14z"/></svg>';
        var FV_MUTE_SVG = '<svg class="icon-sound" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M11 5 6 9H2v6h4l5 4V5z" fill="currentColor" stroke="none"/><path d="M15.5 8.5a5 5 0 0 1 0 7"/><path d="M18.4 5.6a9 9 0 0 1 0 12.8"/></svg>' +
          '<svg class="icon-muted" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M11 5 6 9H2v6h4l5 4V5z" fill="currentColor" stroke="none"/><line x1="22" y1="9" x2="16" y2="15"/><line x1="16" y1="9" x2="22" y2="15"/></svg>';
        var factoryBand = document.getElementById("factoryBand");
        var factoryPillBtn = document.getElementById("factoryPillBtn");
        var factoryAccItem = document.getElementById("factoryAccItem");
        var factoryVideo = null;
        var factoryPlayBtn = null;
        var factoryMuteBtn = null;
        var fvSource = "";      // "" | "primary" | "fallback"
        var fvWantPlay = false; // user intent: should be playing now
        var fvWatchdog = null;
        var fvResumeAt = 0;     // position restored after a failover swap
        // Slideshow + reel state.
        var reelVideo = null;
        var fvViewport = null;
        var fvStageReel = null;
        var fvStageFactory = null;
        var fvArrowPrev = null;
        var fvArrowNext = null;
        var fvIndex = 0;
        var fvScrollTimer = null;
        var rvSource = "";      // "" | "primary" | "fallback"
        var rvWantPlay = false; // user intent: should be playing now
        var rvWatchdog = null;
        var rvResumeAt = 0;     // position restored after a failover swap
        // Viewport height per unit width, per slide (reel 16:9, factory portrait).
        var FV_RATIOS = [9 / 16, 900 / 614];
        function fvSyncMuteBtn() {
          if (!factoryMuteBtn || !factoryVideo) return;
          factoryMuteBtn.classList.toggle("is-muted", factoryVideo.muted);
          factoryMuteBtn.setAttribute("aria-pressed", factoryVideo.muted ? "true" : "false");
          factoryMuteBtn.setAttribute("aria-label", factoryVideo.muted ? "Unmute video" : "Mute video");
        }
        function fvSyncPlayBtn() {
          if (!factoryPlayBtn || !factoryVideo) return;
          var show = factoryVideo.paused || factoryVideo.ended;
          factoryPlayBtn.classList.toggle("is-hidden", !show);
        }
        function fvClearWatchdog() {
          if (fvWatchdog) { clearTimeout(fvWatchdog); fvWatchdog = null; }
        }
        function fvSetSource(kind) {
          fvSource = kind;
          factoryVideo.src = kind === "primary" ? FV_PRIMARY : FV_FALLBACK;
        }
        function fvFailover() {
          if (!factoryVideo || fvSource === "fallback") return;
          fvResumeAt = 0;
          try { fvResumeAt = factoryVideo.currentTime || 0; } catch (e) {}
          fvSetSource("fallback");
          try { factoryVideo.load(); } catch (e) {}
          if (fvWantPlay) fvAttemptPlay();
        }
        function fvArmWatchdog() {
          fvClearWatchdog();
          fvWatchdog = setTimeout(function () {
            fvWatchdog = null;
            if (!fvWantPlay || !factoryVideo) return;
            // Playing with data in hand = the current source is fine.
            if (!factoryVideo.paused && factoryVideo.readyState >= 3) return;
            fvFailover();
          }, 4000);
        }
        function fvAttemptPlay() {
          fvArmWatchdog();
          var p = factoryVideo.play();
          if (p && p.catch) {
            p.catch(function () { fvFailover(); });
          }
        }
        // Start (or resume) playback. The element may still be idle when
        // the tap lands, so kick load() first, in the same gesture.
        function fvPlay() {
          if (!factoryVideo) return;
          fvWantPlay = true;
          if (!fvSource) fvSetSource("primary");
          if (factoryVideo.readyState === 0) {
            try { factoryVideo.load(); } catch (e) {}
          }
          fvAttemptPlay();
        }
        function fvBuildPlayer() {
          factoryVideo = document.createElement("video");
          factoryVideo.id = "factoryVideo";
          factoryVideo.setAttribute("poster", FV_POSTER);
          factoryVideo.setAttribute("preload", "none");
          factoryVideo.setAttribute("loop", "");
          factoryVideo.setAttribute("playsinline", "");
          factoryVideo.setAttribute("webkit-playsinline", "");
          factoryVideo.setAttribute("aria-label", "Building our robotics factory! — tap the play button to watch with sound; tap the video to pause");
          factoryVideo.muted = false;
          factoryPlayBtn = document.createElement("button");
          factoryPlayBtn.type = "button";
          factoryPlayBtn.className = "factory-play-btn";
          factoryPlayBtn.id = "factoryPlayBtn";
          factoryPlayBtn.setAttribute("aria-label", "Play video");
          factoryPlayBtn.innerHTML = FV_PLAY_SVG;
          factoryMuteBtn = document.createElement("button");
          factoryMuteBtn.type = "button";
          factoryMuteBtn.className = "factory-mute-btn";
          factoryMuteBtn.id = "factoryMuteBtn";
          factoryMuteBtn.setAttribute("aria-label", "Mute video");
          factoryMuteBtn.setAttribute("aria-pressed", "false");
          factoryMuteBtn.innerHTML = FV_MUTE_SVG;
          fvStageFactory.appendChild(factoryVideo);
          fvStageFactory.appendChild(factoryPlayBtn);
          fvStageFactory.appendChild(factoryMuteBtn);
          fvSyncMuteBtn();
          fvSyncPlayBtn();
          factoryVideo.addEventListener("volumechange", fvSyncMuteBtn);
          factoryVideo.addEventListener("play", fvSyncPlayBtn);
          factoryVideo.addEventListener("playing", function () {
            fvWantPlay = true;
            fvClearWatchdog();
            fvSyncPlayBtn();
          });
          factoryVideo.addEventListener("timeupdate", function () {
            if (factoryVideo && !factoryVideo.paused) fvClearWatchdog();
          });
          factoryVideo.addEventListener("pause", fvSyncPlayBtn);
          factoryVideo.addEventListener("ended", fvSyncPlayBtn);
          factoryVideo.addEventListener("error", function () {
            if (fvWantPlay) fvFailover();
          });
          factoryVideo.addEventListener("waiting", function () { if (fvWantPlay) fvArmWatchdog(); });
          factoryVideo.addEventListener("stalled", function () { if (fvWantPlay) fvArmWatchdog(); });
          factoryVideo.addEventListener("loadedmetadata", function () {
            if (fvResumeAt > 0 && factoryVideo) {
              try { factoryVideo.currentTime = fvResumeAt; } catch (e) {}
              fvResumeAt = 0;
            }
          });
          factoryVideo.addEventListener("click", function () {
            if (factoryVideo.paused) {
              fvPlay();
            } else {
              fvWantPlay = false;
              fvClearWatchdog();
              factoryVideo.pause();
            }
          });
          factoryVideo.addEventListener("webkitbeginfullscreen", function (e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            if (factoryVideo.webkitExitFullscreen) factoryVideo.webkitExitFullscreen();
          });
          factoryPlayBtn.addEventListener("click", function () {
            fvPlay();
          });
          factoryMuteBtn.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
            e.stopPropagation();
            factoryVideo.muted = !factoryVideo.muted;
            fvSyncMuteBtn();
          });
        }
        function fvTeardownPlayer() {
          fvWantPlay = false;
          fvClearWatchdog();
          if (factoryVideo) {
            try { factoryVideo.pause(); } catch (e) {}
            try {
              factoryVideo.removeAttribute("src");
              factoryVideo.load();
            } catch (e) {}
          }
          factoryVideo = null;
          factoryPlayBtn = null;
          factoryMuteBtn = null;
          fvSource = "";
          fvResumeAt = 0;
        }
        // ---- Reel (slide 1) — the new Sourccey film. Same delivery
        // discipline as the factory film: primary stream with an
        // automatic failover to the bundled copy if play() rejects, the
        // media errors, or no progress lands within ~4 seconds. The
        // standing formula holds: direct file URL, preload="auto",
        // playsinline + webkit-playsinline, tap the video to toggle
        // pause/play, NO center play overlay, the poster shows the
        // first frame before any tap, and the webkitbeginfullscreen
        // guard keeps iPhone from hijacking fullscreen. Sound is native
        // and never muted — there is no unmute step. ----
        function rvClearWatchdog() {
          if (rvWatchdog) { clearTimeout(rvWatchdog); rvWatchdog = null; }
        }
        function rvSetSource(kind) {
          rvSource = kind;
          reelVideo.src = kind === "primary" ? REEL_PRIMARY : REEL_FALLBACK;
        }
        function rvFailover() {
          if (!reelVideo || rvSource === "fallback") return;
          rvResumeAt = 0;
          try { rvResumeAt = reelVideo.currentTime || 0; } catch (e) {}
          rvSetSource("fallback");
          try { reelVideo.load(); } catch (e) {}
          if (rvWantPlay) rvAttemptPlay();
        }
        function rvArmWatchdog() {
          rvClearWatchdog();
          rvWatchdog = setTimeout(function () {
            rvWatchdog = null;
            if (!rvWantPlay || !reelVideo) return;
            if (!reelVideo.paused && reelVideo.readyState >= 3) return;
            rvFailover();
          }, 4000);
        }
        function rvAttemptPlay() {
          rvArmWatchdog();
          var p = reelVideo.play();
          if (p && p.catch) {
            p.catch(function () { rvFailover(); });
          }
        }
        function rvPlay() {
          if (!reelVideo) return;
          rvWantPlay = true;
          if (!rvSource) rvSetSource("primary");
          if (reelVideo.readyState === 0) {
            try { reelVideo.load(); } catch (e) {}
          }
          rvAttemptPlay();
        }
        function rvPause() {
          rvWantPlay = false;
          rvClearWatchdog();
          if (reelVideo) {
            try { reelVideo.pause(); } catch (e) {}
          }
        }
        function rvBuildPlayer() {
          reelVideo = document.createElement("video");
          reelVideo.id = "reelVideo";
          reelVideo.setAttribute("poster", REEL_POSTER);
          reelVideo.setAttribute("preload", "auto");
          reelVideo.setAttribute("loop", "");
          reelVideo.setAttribute("playsinline", "");
          reelVideo.setAttribute("webkit-playsinline", "");
          reelVideo.setAttribute("aria-label", "Meet Sourccey — the new film. Tap to play with sound; tap again to pause.");
          reelVideo.muted = false;
          reelVideo.volume = 1;
          fvStageReel.appendChild(reelVideo);
          reelVideo.addEventListener("playing", function () {
            rvWantPlay = true;
            rvClearWatchdog();
          });
          reelVideo.addEventListener("timeupdate", function () {
            if (reelVideo && !reelVideo.paused) rvClearWatchdog();
          });
          reelVideo.addEventListener("error", function () {
            if (rvWantPlay) rvFailover();
          });
          reelVideo.addEventListener("waiting", function () { if (rvWantPlay) rvArmWatchdog(); });
          reelVideo.addEventListener("stalled", function () { if (rvWantPlay) rvArmWatchdog(); });
          reelVideo.addEventListener("loadedmetadata", function () {
            if (rvResumeAt > 0 && reelVideo) {
              try { reelVideo.currentTime = rvResumeAt; } catch (e) {}
              rvResumeAt = 0;
            }
          });
          reelVideo.addEventListener("click", function () {
            if (reelVideo.paused) {
              rvPlay();
            } else {
              rvPause();
            }
          });
          reelVideo.addEventListener("webkitbeginfullscreen", function (e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            if (reelVideo.webkitExitFullscreen) reelVideo.webkitExitFullscreen();
          });
        }

        // ---- Slideshow shell: track, slides, arrows, swipe sync. ----
        function fvSyncHeight() {
          if (!fvViewport) return;
          var w = fvViewport.clientWidth || (factoryBand ? factoryBand.clientWidth : 0);
          if (w > 0) fvViewport.style.height = Math.round(w * FV_RATIOS[fvIndex]) + "px";
        }
        function fvSyncArrows() {
          if (fvArrowPrev) {
            var disPrev = fvIndex <= 0;
            fvArrowPrev.classList.toggle("is-disabled", disPrev);
            fvArrowPrev.setAttribute("aria-disabled", disPrev ? "true" : "false");
          }
          if (fvArrowNext) {
            var disNext = fvIndex >= 1;
            fvArrowNext.classList.toggle("is-disabled", disNext);
            fvArrowNext.setAttribute("aria-disabled", disNext ? "true" : "false");
          }
        }
        function fvSetIndex(i) {
          fvIndex = i;
          // The film left behind pauses; nothing plays off-screen.
          if (fvIndex !== 0) rvPause();
          if (fvIndex !== 1 && factoryVideo && !factoryVideo.paused) {
            fvWantPlay = false;
            fvClearWatchdog();
            try { factoryVideo.pause(); } catch (e) {}
          }
          fvSyncHeight();
          fvSyncArrows();
        }
        function fvGoTo(i) {
          if (!fvViewport) return;
          i = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, i));
          fvSetIndex(i);
          var reduce = false;
          try { reduce = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches; } catch (e) {}
          fvViewport.scrollTo({ left: i * fvViewport.clientWidth, behavior: reduce ? "auto" : "smooth" });
        }
        function fvBuildSlideshow() {
          fvIndex = 0;
          fvViewport = document.createElement("div");
          fvViewport.className = "fv-viewport";
          fvViewport.id = "fvViewport";
          var track = document.createElement("div");
          track.className = "fv-track";
          var slide1 = document.createElement("div");
          slide1.className = "fv-slide";
          fvStageReel = document.createElement("div");
          fvStageReel.className = "fv-stage fv-stage-reel";
          slide1.appendChild(fvStageReel);
          var slide2 = document.createElement("div");
          slide2.className = "fv-slide";
          fvStageFactory = document.createElement("div");
          fvStageFactory.className = "fv-stage fv-stage-factory";
          slide2.appendChild(fvStageFactory);
          track.appendChild(slide1);
          track.appendChild(slide2);
          fvViewport.appendChild(track);
          factoryBand.appendChild(fvViewport);
          fvArrowPrev = document.createElement("button");
          fvArrowPrev.type = "button";
          fvArrowPrev.className = "fv-arrow fv-arrow-prev";
          fvArrowPrev.id = "fvArrowPrev";
          fvArrowPrev.setAttribute("aria-label", "Previous video");
          fvArrowPrev.innerHTML = FV_CHEV_L;
          fvArrowNext = document.createElement("button");
          fvArrowNext.type = "button";
          fvArrowNext.className = "fv-arrow fv-arrow-next";
          fvArrowNext.id = "fvArrowNext";
          fvArrowNext.setAttribute("aria-label", "Next video");
          fvArrowNext.innerHTML = FV_CHEV_R;
          factoryBand.appendChild(fvArrowPrev);
          factoryBand.appendChild(fvArrowNext);
          fvArrowPrev.addEventListener("click", function () { fvGoTo(fvIndex - 1); });
          fvArrowNext.addEventListener("click", function () { fvGoTo(fvIndex + 1); });
          fvViewport.addEventListener("scroll", function () {
            if (fvScrollTimer) clearTimeout(fvScrollTimer);
            fvScrollTimer = setTimeout(function () {
              if (!fvViewport) return;
              var w = fvViewport.clientWidth || 1;
              fvSetIndex(Math.max(0, Math.min(1, Math.round(fvViewport.scrollLeft / w))));
            }, 90);
          }, { passive: true });
          window.addEventListener("resize", fvSyncHeight);
          rvBuildPlayer();
          fvBuildPlayer();
          fvSyncHeight();
          fvSyncArrows();
        }
        function fvTeardownSlideshow() {
          window.removeEventListener("resize", fvSyncHeight);
          if (fvScrollTimer) { clearTimeout(fvScrollTimer); fvScrollTimer = null; }
          rvWantPlay = false;
          rvClearWatchdog();
          if (reelVideo) {
            try { reelVideo.pause(); } catch (e) {}
            try {
              reelVideo.removeAttribute("src");
              reelVideo.load();
            } catch (e) {}
          }
          fvTeardownPlayer();
          if (factoryBand) factoryBand.innerHTML = "";
          reelVideo = null;
          fvViewport = null;
          fvStageReel = null;
          fvStageFactory = null;
          fvArrowPrev = null;
          fvArrowNext = null;
          rvSource = "";
          rvResumeAt = 0;
          fvIndex = 0;
        }
        if (factoryPillBtn && factoryAccItem && factoryBand) {
          factoryPillBtn.addEventListener("click", function () {
            var open = factoryAccItem.classList.toggle("open");
            factoryPillBtn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", open ? "true" : "false");
            if (open) {
              if (!fvViewport) fvBuildSlideshow();
              rvPlay();
            } else {
              fvTeardownSlideshow();
            }
          });
        }

        // Accordions — one open at a time per group, all closed on load.
        // Each .acc container (kit picker, classes) is its own group.
        document.querySelectorAll(".acc").forEach(function (group) {
          var items = Array.prototype.slice.call(group.querySelectorAll(".acc-item"));
          items.forEach(function (item) {
            var btn = item.querySelector(".acc-btn");
            btn.addEventListener("click", function () {
              var wasOpen = item.classList.contains("open");
              items.forEach(function (other) {
                other.classList.remove("open");
                other.querySelector(".acc-btn").setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
              });
              if (!wasOpen) {
                item.classList.add("open");
                btn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "true");
              }
            });
          });
        });

        // Admin One-Pager viewer — the document image is set on first
        // open only, so it costs zero bytes on page load. The print-only copy gets the same src:
        // PRINT is only reachable from this sheet, so it is always set
        // before a print can happen, and it is the cached image.
        var adminBuilt = false;
        function buildAdminPage() {
          if (adminBuilt) return;
          adminBuilt = true;
          var img = document.getElementById("adminDocImg");
          if (img) img.src = "data:image/webp;base64,";
          var pimg = document.getElementById("printOnepagerImg");
          if (pimg) pimg.src = "data:image/webp;base64,";
        }

        // Assembly Manual viewer — all 163 page figures are wired on
        // first open only, so the book costs zero bytes on page load.
        // Page images load as the scroll approaches them, driven by
        // an IntersectionObserver rooted at the book's own scroller:
        // native lazy loading inside this nested scroller proved
        // unreliable on iPhone Safari (alternating pages left as
        // broken-image placeholders), so proximity loading is done
        // here instead — and a page whose load fails is retried,
        // never left as a placeholder.
        var manualBuilt = false;
        function buildManualPages() {
          if (manualBuilt) return;
          manualBuilt = true;
          var wrap = document.getElementById("man-pages");
          if (!wrap) return;
          function manSrc(n) { return "assets/manual/p" + String(n).padStart(3, "0") + ".webp"; }
          function manLoad(img, n) {
            if (img.dataset.manDone || img.dataset.manLoading) return;
            img.dataset.manLoading = "1";
            var tries = 0;
            img.onload = function () {
              img.dataset.manDone = "1";
              img.dataset.manLoading = "";
              img.onload = img.onerror = null;
            };
            img.onerror = function () {
              tries++;
              if (tries > 3) { img.dataset.manLoading = ""; img.onload = img.onerror = null; return; }
              img.removeAttribute("src");
              setTimeout(function () { img.src = manSrc(n); }, 300 * tries);
            };
            img.src = manSrc(n);
          }
          var manImgs = [];
          for (var n = 1; n <= 163; n++) {
            var fig = document.createElement("figure");
            fig.id = "man-page-" + n;
            var img = document.createElement("img");
            img.width = 1445;
            img.height = 1870;
            img.alt = "Assembly Manual page " + n + " of 163";
            img.dataset.manPage = n;
            var cap = document.createElement("figcaption");
            cap.textContent = "Page " + n + " of 163";
            fig.appendChild(img);
            fig.appendChild(cap);
            wrap.appendChild(fig);
            manImgs.push(img);
          }
          // The first pages load immediately — the top of the book is
          // never blank while the observer warms up.
          for (var f = 0; f < Math.min(4, manImgs.length); f++) manLoad(manImgs[f], f + 1);
          // Jump-to-page (Ask the Manual citations) force-loads its
          // target through this hook instead of waiting on proximity.
          wrap._manLoadPage = function (n) {
            var im = manImgs[n - 1];
            if (im) manLoad(im, n);
          };
          if ("IntersectionObserver" in window) {
            var manIO = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
              entries.forEach(function (en) {
                if (!en.isIntersecting) return;
                var im = en.target.querySelector("img");
                if (im) manLoad(im, parseInt(im.dataset.manPage, 10));
                manIO.unobserve(en.target);
              });
            }, { root: wrap, rootMargin: "900px 0px" });
            for (var g = 0; g < manImgs.length; g++) manIO.observe(manImgs[g].parentNode);
          } else {
            for (var h = 0; h < manImgs.length; h++) manLoad(manImgs[h], h + 1);
          }
        }

        // MANUAL AGENT — "Ask the Manual" (bar at the top of the
        // ASSEMBLY MANUAL sheet). Answers come ONLY from
        // window.MANUAL_KB (data:application/javascript;base64,), transcribed page
        // by page from the shipped manual, plus the curriculum's
        // Troubleshooting Clinic. Two modes:
        //   KNOWN — the KB holds it: answer + "Manual page N" cite
        //     + a tap that scrolls the sheet to that page.
        //   FIGURE IT OUT — the exact case isn't written down: a
        //     worked-out diagnostic path whose every step is a
        //     documented component, procedure, or page. It never
        //     states an undocumented spec (rating, gauge, torque,
        //     dimension); Discord appears only as the final step.
        var MAN_KB = window.MANUAL_KB || [];
        var MAN_STOP = { the: 1, a: 1, an: 1, of: 1, to: 1, in: 1, on: 1, for: 1, is: 1, are: 1, do: 1, does: 1, did: 1, how: 1, where: 1, what: 1, which: 1, when: 1, why: 1, i: 1, my: 1, me: 1, it: 1, its: 1, that: 1, this: 1, with: 1, and: 1, or: 1, can: 1, could: 1, should: 1, would: 1, need: 1, get: 1, go: 1, find: 1, show: 1, tell: 1, page: 1, pages: 1, manual: 1, please: 1, into: 1, from: 1, about: 1, there: 1, one: 1, two: 1, all: 1, any: 1, was: 1, were: 1, be: 1, been: 1, has: 1, have: 1, had: 1, you: 1, your: 1, we: 1, they: 1, them: 1, then: 1, than: 1, if: 1, but: 1, just: 1, like: 1, use: 1, using: 1, used: 1, make: 1, makes: 1 };
        function manNorm(w) {
          w = String(w).toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, "");
          if (w.length > 4 && /ing$/.test(w)) w = w.slice(0, -3);
          if (w.length > 4 && /ed$/.test(w)) w = w.slice(0, -2);
          if (w.length > 3 && /s$/.test(w) && !/ss$/.test(w)) w = w.slice(0, -1);
          return w;
        }
        function manTokenSet(text) {
          var set = {};
          String(text).toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9 ]/g, " ").split(/\s+/).forEach(function (w) {
            var n = manNorm(w);
            if (n) set[n] = 1;
          });
          return set;
        }
        function manPrep() {
          MAN_KB.forEach(function (e) {
            if (!e._t) { e._t = manTokenSet(e.t); e._x = manTokenSet(e.x); }
          });
        }
        function manExcerpt(x, n) {
          if (x.length <= n) return x;
          var cut = x.slice(0, n), dot = cut.lastIndexOf(". ");
          if (dot > n * 0.5) return cut.slice(0, dot + 1);
          return cut + "…";
        }
        function manJump(n) {
          buildManualPages();
          var wrap = document.getElementById("man-pages");
          var fig = document.getElementById("man-page-" + n);
          if (!wrap || !fig) return;
          if (wrap._manLoadPage) wrap._manLoadPage(n);
          requestAnimationFrame(function () {
            requestAnimationFrame(function () {
              wrap.scrollTop = Math.max(0, fig.offsetTop - wrap.offsetTop - 12);
              fig.classList.add("man-hit");
              setTimeout(function () { fig.classList.remove("man-hit"); }, 2400);
            });
          });
        }
        function manJumpBtn(n, label) {
          var b = document.createElement("button");
          b.type = "button";
          b.className = "man-jump-btn";
          b.textContent = label || ("Page " + n + " ↓");
          b.addEventListener("click", function () { manJump(n); });
          return b;
        }

        function manPickPath(low) {
          for (var i = 0; i < MAN_PATHS.length; i++) {
            if (MAN_PATHS[i].rx.test(low)) return MAN_PATHS[i];
          }
          return null;
        }
        function manEl(tag, cls, text) {
          var el = document.createElement(tag);
          if (cls) el.className = cls;
          if (text != null) el.textContent = text;
          return el;
        }
        function manRenderPath(box, path) {
          var card = manEl("div", "man-ans");
          card.appendChild(manEl("div", "man-tag", path.tag));
          card.appendChild(manEl("div", "man-ans-body", path.frame));
          var ol = manEl("ol", "man-steps");
          path.steps.forEach(function (st) {
            var li = manEl("li", null, st[0]);
            if (st[1]) li.appendChild(manJumpBtn(st[1]));
            ol.appendChild(li);
          });
          card.appendChild(ol);
          box.appendChild(card);
        }
        function manRenderKnown(box, scored) {
          var top = scored[0].e;
          var card = manEl("div", "man-ans");
          card.appendChild(manEl("div", "man-tag", top.src === "clinic" ? "FROM THE TROUBLESHOOTING CLINIC" : ("FROM THE MANUAL — " + top.s).toUpperCase()));
          card.appendChild(manEl("div", "man-ans-title", top.t));
          card.appendChild(manEl("div", "man-ans-body", manExcerpt(top.x, 340)));
          var row = manEl("div", "man-cite-row");
          row.appendChild(manEl("span", "man-cite", "Manual page " + top.p + " of 163"));
          row.appendChild(manJumpBtn(top.p, "Go to page " + top.p + " ↓"));
          card.appendChild(row);
          box.appendChild(card);
          if (scored.length > 1) {
            var more = manEl("div", "man-more");
            more.appendChild(manEl("div", "man-more-label", "ALSO IN THE MANUAL"));
            scored.slice(1, 4).forEach(function (s) {
              var r = manEl("button", "man-row");
              r.type = "button";
              r.appendChild(manEl("span", null, s.e.t));
              r.appendChild(manEl("span", "man-row-page", "Page " + s.e.p + " of 163"));
              r.addEventListener("click", function () { manJump(s.e.p); });
              more.appendChild(r);
            });
            box.appendChild(more);
          }
        }
        function manAsk() {
          var input = document.getElementById("manAskInput");
          var box = document.getElementById("manResults");
          if (!input || !box) return;
          var raw = input.value.replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
          box.innerHTML = "";
          if (!raw) { box.hidden = true; return; }
          box.hidden = false;
          // The results render at the top of the book (in its scroll
          // flow) — bring the book back to its top so the answer is
          // on screen the moment it renders.
          var manWrap = document.getElementById("man-pages");
          if (manWrap) manWrap.scrollTop = 0;
          if (!MAN_KB.length) {
            box.appendChild(manEl("div", "man-none", "The manual index didn't load — the pages below are still the full book; scroll to browse."));
            return;
          }
          manPrep();
          var low = " " + raw.toLowerCase() + " ";
          var toks = [], seen = {};
          raw.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9 ]/g, " ").split(/\s+/).forEach(function (w) {
            var n = manNorm(w);
            if (n && !MAN_STOP[n] && !seen[n]) { seen[n] = 1; toks.push(n); }
          });
          var scored = [];
          MAN_KB.forEach(function (e) {
            var s = 0;
            toks.forEach(function (t) {
              if (e._t[t]) s += 3;
              else if (e._x[t]) s += 1;
            });
            if (s > 0 && e.b) s += e.b;
            if (s > 0) scored.push({ e: e, s: s });
          });
          scored.sort(function (a, b) { return b.s - a.s || a.e.p - b.e.p; });
          var path = manPickPath(low);
          if (path) { manRenderPath(box, path); return; }
          if (/\b(price|prices|cost|tuition|discount|coupon|refund|shipping|in stock|buy|purchase)\b/.test(low) || /enroll/.test(low)) {
            box.appendChild(manEl("div", "man-none", "That's outside the manual — prices, classes, and enrollment live with the main Ask Sourccey at the bottom of the page. Here I answer from the Assembly Manual only."));
            return;
          }
          if (scored.length && scored[0].s >= 3) { manRenderKnown(box, scored); return; }
          box.appendChild(manEl("div", "man-none", "No matches in the manual. Try a part or a step — “fuse”, “battery”, “power switch”, “servo ID” — or ask it as a question: “how do I test the fuses?”"));
        }
        var manAskBtn = document.getElementById("manAskBtn");
        if (manAskBtn) manAskBtn.addEventListener("click", manAsk);
        var manAskInput = document.getElementById("manAskInput");
        if (manAskInput) manAskInput.addEventListener("keydown", function (ev) {
          if (ev.key === "Enter") { ev.preventDefault(); manAsk(); }
        });

        // Kit sheets (modal panels)
        var lastFocus = null;
        function openSheet(id) {
          var overlay = document.getElementById(id);
          if (!overlay) return;
          if (id === "sheet-admin") buildAdminPage();
          if (id === "sheet-manual") buildManualPages();
          // No autofocus on open (owner order, 2026-10-23): focusing a
          // field as its sheet opens makes iOS Safari auto-zoom and pop
          // the keyboard uninvited. The fields are 16px, so a deliberate
          // tap focuses them with no zoom at all.
          lastFocus = document.activeElement;
          var wasShown = overlay.classList.contains("show");
          overlay.hidden = false;
          // force reflow so the display:flex class animates in
          void overlay.offsetWidth;
          overlay.classList.add("show");
          // Pin the page behind for as long as this sheet is open, so
          // scrolling the sheet can never drag the homepage with it.
          if (!wasShown) lockPageScroll();
          if (id === "sheet-curriculum") {
            // Land at the top of the new curriculum; the courses sheet
            // (a layer above this one) always starts closed.
            if (window.__ncForceCloseCourses) window.__ncForceCloseCourses();
            var currSheet = overlay.querySelector(".curr-sheet");
            if (currSheet) currSheet.scrollTop = 0;
          }
          var closeBtn = overlay.querySelector("[data-close]");
          if (closeBtn) closeBtn.focus();
        }
        function closeSheet(overlay) {
          var wasShown = overlay.classList.contains("show");
          overlay.classList.remove("show");
          overlay.hidden = true;
          // Release this sheet's hold on the page lock; the page frees
          // only when the last open popup closes (see lockPageScroll).
          if (wasShown) unlockPageScroll();
          if (overlay.id === "sheet-packingmap") {
            var pages = document.getElementById("pm-pages");
            if (pages) pages.scrollTop = 0;
          }
          if (overlay.id === "sheet-admin") {
            var apages = document.getElementById("admin-pages");
            if (apages) apages.scrollTop = 0;
          }
          if (overlay.id === "sheet-manual") {
            var mpages = document.getElementById("man-pages");
            if (mpages) mpages.scrollTop = 0;
          }
          if (lastFocus && lastFocus.focus) lastFocus.focus();
        }
        document.querySelectorAll("[data-open]").forEach(function (btn) {
          btn.addEventListener("click", function () { openSheet(btn.getAttribute("data-open")); });
        });

        // LAYER PACKING MAP (PDF) — the quiet secondary link inside each kit's
        // specs overview; opens the Packing Map PDF in the full-screen
        // viewer, landed on the tapped kit's layer pages. (The specs panel's
        // main button is SEE ALL PARTS — the priced parts list, in-page.)
        document.querySelectorAll("[data-pdf]").forEach(function (btn) {
          btn.addEventListener("click", function () {
            var sub = document.getElementById("pm-sub");
            var label = btn.getAttribute("data-pdf-label");
            if (sub && label) sub.textContent = label;
            openSheet("sheet-packingmap");
            // Land on the tapped kit's first layer page — the document is
            // rendered as page images (the embedded PDF viewer renders
            // blank in-app), the whole 6-page document scrolls from there.
            var startPage = btn.getAttribute("data-pdf");
            requestAnimationFrame(function () {
              requestAnimationFrame(function () {
                var container = document.getElementById("pm-pages");
                var target = document.getElementById("pm-page-" + startPage);
                if (container && target) {
                  container.scrollTop = Math.max(0, target.offsetTop - container.offsetTop - 12);
                } else if (container) {
                  container.scrollTop = 0;
                }
              });
            });
          });
        });
        // BUILT BOX PACKING MAP (PDF) — same pattern, its own viewer and
        // document (cardboard box + black styrofoam cradle).
        document.querySelectorAll("[data-pdfb]").forEach(function (btn) {
          btn.addEventListener("click", function () {
            var sub = document.getElementById("pmb-sub");
            var label = btn.getAttribute("data-pdfb-label");
            if (sub && label) sub.textContent = label;
            openSheet("sheet-builtmap");
            requestAnimationFrame(function () {
              requestAnimationFrame(function () {
                var container = document.getElementById("pmb-pages");
                if (container) container.scrollTop = 0;
              });
            });
          });
        });
        document.querySelectorAll(".sheet-overlay").forEach(function (overlay) {
          overlay.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
            if (e.target === overlay) closeSheet(overlay);
          });
          overlay.querySelectorAll("[data-close]").forEach(function (btn) {
            btn.addEventListener("click", function () { closeSheet(overlay); });
          });
        });
        document.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
          if (e.key === "Escape") {
            document.querySelectorAll(".sheet-overlay.show").forEach(closeSheet);
          }
        });

        // Sheet pills — specs / extra parts panels, one open at a time per sheet
        document.querySelectorAll(".sheet").forEach(function (sheet) {
          var pills = sheet.querySelectorAll("[data-panel]");
          pills.forEach(function (pill) {
            pill.addEventListener("click", function () {
              var body = sheet.querySelector('[data-panel-body="' + pill.getAttribute("data-panel") + '"]');
              if (!body) return;
              var wasOpen = body.classList.contains("open");
              sheet.querySelectorAll(".sheet-panel").forEach(function (p) { p.classList.remove("open"); });
              pills.forEach(function (b) { b.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false"); });
              if (!wasOpen) {
                body.classList.add("open");
                pill.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "true");
              }
            });
          });
        });
        // View-state keeper hook: a session restore re-opens the sheet
        // the visitor had open when the shell reloaded the page.
        if (window.SV) { SV.openSheet = openSheet; SV.closeSheet = closeSheet; }
      })();
    </script>
    <script>
      (function () {
        // ENROLL NOW (hero) — the pill is a collapse: it opens the
        // path chooser inline (School program / Online course / Buy
        // the kit — wired in the next block). The school path reveals
        // the enrollment form; the form's SEND composes an email to
        // the Sourccey sales inbox, and the team confirms dates
        // from there.
        var btn = document.getElementById('enrollNowBtn');
        var panel = document.getElementById('enrollPanel');
        if (btn && panel) {
          btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
            var opening = !panel.classList.contains('open');
            panel.classList.toggle('open', opening);
            btn.classList.toggle('open', opening);
            btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', opening ? 'true' : 'false');
            // The Ask launcher yields while this panel is open.
            syncAskLauncherYield();
          });
        }
      })();

      (function () {
        // ENROLL NOW path chooser — two routes out of the ENROLL
        // panel. School program expands the existing enrollment form
        // inline beneath the choices (the form itself is unchanged).
        // Online course closes this panel, opens the Online Courses
        // panel, and scrolls it into view (the same route the Ways
        // to Join demo card takes).
        var enrollBtn = document.getElementById('enrollNowBtn');
        var enrollPanel = document.getElementById('enrollPanel');
        var onlinePanel = document.getElementById('onlinePanel');
        var schoolBtn = document.getElementById('enrollPathSchool');
        var formRegion = document.getElementById('enrollSchoolForm');
        var backFloat = document.getElementById('enrollBackFloat');
        var activePath = null;
        function closeEnroll() {
          if (!enrollPanel || !enrollBtn) return;
          enrollPanel.classList.remove('open');
          enrollBtn.classList.remove('open');
          enrollBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
          if (typeof syncAskLauncherYield === 'function') syncAskLauncherYield();
        }
        // BACK CONTROLS — entering any path arms the floating Back
        // pill; one tap on any Back control closes the destination
        // view, re-opens the chooser, and scrolls it back into view.
        function showBack(path) {
          activePath = path;
          if (backFloat) backFloat.hidden = false;
        }
        function hideBack() {
          activePath = null;
          if (backFloat) backFloat.hidden = true;
        }
        function backToChoices() {
          if (formRegion) formRegion.classList.remove('open');
          if (schoolBtn) schoolBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
          if (onlinePanel && onlinePanel.classList.contains('open')) {
            onlinePanel.classList.remove('open');
          }
          hideBack();
          if (enrollPanel && enrollBtn) {
            enrollPanel.classList.add('open');
            enrollBtn.classList.add('open');
            enrollBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
          }
          if (typeof syncAskLauncherYield === 'function') syncAskLauncherYield();
          setTimeout(function () {
            if (enrollPanel) enrollPanel.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
          }, 60);
        }
        document.querySelectorAll('[data-enroll-back]').forEach(function (b) {
          b.addEventListener('click', backToChoices);
        });
        if (backFloat) backFloat.addEventListener('click', backToChoices);
        if (schoolBtn && formRegion) {
          schoolBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
            var opening = !formRegion.classList.contains('open');
            formRegion.classList.toggle('open', opening);
            schoolBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', opening ? 'true' : 'false');
            if (opening) {
              showBack('school');
              setTimeout(function () {
                var form = formRegion.querySelector('.demo-form');
                if (form) form.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'nearest' });
              }, 390);
            } else if (activePath === 'school') {
              hideBack();
            }
          });
        }
        var onlineBtn = document.getElementById('enrollPathOnline');
        if (onlineBtn) {
          onlineBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
            closeEnroll();
            if (!onlinePanel) return;
            if (!onlinePanel.classList.contains('open')) {
              onlinePanel.classList.add('open');
              if (typeof syncAskLauncherYield === 'function') syncAskLauncherYield();
            }
            showBack('online');
            setTimeout(function () {
              onlinePanel.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
            }, 60);
          });
        }
      })();

      (function () {
        // REQUEST DEMO (hero) — same collapse pattern as ENROLL NOW:
        // the pill opens the demo form inline. Its SEND composes an
        // email to the Sourccey sales inbox, and the team sets the
        // demo up from there.
        var btn = document.getElementById('requestDemoBtn');
        var panel = document.getElementById('demoPanel');
        if (btn && panel) {
          btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
            var opening = !panel.classList.contains('open');
            panel.classList.toggle('open', opening);
            btn.classList.toggle('open', opening);
            btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', opening ? 'true' : 'false');
            // The Ask launcher yields while this panel is open.
            syncAskLauncherYield();
          });
        }
      })();

      (function () {

        // TRACK PICKER — one course, three presentations. Picking a

          });

            var ph = head.closest('.oc-phase');

            head.setAttribute('aria-expanded', nowOpen ? 'true' : 'false');

      (function () {
        // WAYS TO JOIN cards (classes bar 01) — REQUEST DEMO scrolls to the
        // hero pill and opens its contact panel; PURCHASE YOUR SOURCCEY

        var demoCard = document.getElementById('joinDemoCard');

        if (demoCard) {

        var purchaseToggle = document.getElementById('purchaseToggle');

        function compareIsOpen() {
          return !!(compareDetail && compareDetail.classList.contains('open'));
        }
        function setCompare(open) {
          if (compareDetail) compareDetail.classList.toggle('open', open);
          if (compareToggle) compareToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(open));
          if (purchaseToggle) purchaseToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(open));
          if (compareLabel) compareLabel.textContent = open ? 'Hide the full comparison' : 'Tap for the full comparison';
        }
        function toggleCompare() { setCompare(!compareIsOpen()); }
        if (purchaseToggle) purchaseToggle.addEventListener('click', toggleCompare);
        if (compareToggle) compareToggle.addEventListener('click', toggleCompare);
        if (compareHead) compareHead.addEventListener('click', toggleCompare);
        function setPurchase(open) { if (open) setCompare(true); }
        // LOWER-SECTION COLLAPSE (FAQs / Support / Outcomes) is wired
        // by the dedicated script at the end of the page — it used to
        // live here, buried in this shared block; it moved to its own

        // classesToggle / supportToggle / outcomesToggle here: two
        // handlers on one tap would toggle twice and read as broken.

          buyCard.addEventListener('click', function () {
            setPurchase(true);
            var head = document.getElementById('kits-h');
            if (head) head.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });

    <script>
      (function () {
        // CART — in-page only. Prices in integer cents so the math is
        // exact. Checkout is a finalize step: it composes an email to
        // the Sourccey sales inbox (buyer details + cart lines) in the
        // visitor's own email app — no payment is taken. State lives
        // for this page visit.
        var PRODUCTS = {
          built:    { name: "Sourccey Built",        cents: 200000 },
          complete: { name: "Sourccey Complete Kit", cents: 204080 },
          maker:    { name: "Sourccey Maker Kit",    cents: 187788 },
          plushie:  { name: "Sourccey Plushie",      cents: 2999 }
        };
        var ORDER = ["built", "complete", "maker", "plushie"];
        var cart = {}; // key -> quantity

        var countEl = document.getElementById("cartCount");
        var floatEl = document.getElementById("cartFloat");
        var floatCountEl = document.getElementById("cartFloatCount");
        var floatTotalEl = document.getElementById("cartFloatTotal");
        var linesEl = document.getElementById("cartLines");
        var emptyEl = document.getElementById("cartEmpty");
        var totalRowEl = document.getElementById("cartTotalRow");
        var grandEl = document.getElementById("cartGrand");
        var checkoutBtn = document.getElementById("cartCheckout");
        if (!linesEl || !grandEl) return;

        // CART PILL GATE — BOTH cart pills (the header pill beside
        // the Purchase heading and the floating pill) stay hidden at
        // fresh load. They are revealed ONLY once the visitor selects
        // an option in the Purchase area — opening one of the three
        // kit bars, or tapping BUY NOW / SEE INSIDE / ADD TO CART on
        // a kit — or taps the plushie purchase. Once revealed they
        // stay revealed for the rest of the view. The Purchase region
        // being open in the markup does NOT reveal them, and neither
        // do the cart contents: restoring contents on a shell reload
        // never reveals the pills on its own. Contents and badge
        // counts are never touched by the gate.
        var pillEl = document.getElementById("cartPill");
        var cartRevealed = false;
        function applyFloatGate() {
          if (floatEl) {
            floatEl.hidden = !cartRevealed;
            if (!cartRevealed) floatEl.classList.remove("pulse");
          }
          if (pillEl) pillEl.hidden = !cartRevealed;
        }
        function revealCart() {
          if (cartRevealed) return;
          cartRevealed = true;
          applyFloatGate();
        }
        applyFloatGate();
        document.querySelectorAll(".kit-picker .acc-btn").forEach(function (btn) {
          btn.addEventListener("click", revealCart);
        });
        document.querySelectorAll('[data-open="sheet-plushie"], [data-open="sheet-built"], [data-open="sheet-complete"], [data-open="sheet-maker"]').forEach(function (btn) {
          btn.addEventListener("click", revealCart);
        });
        document.querySelectorAll("[data-add]").forEach(function (btn) {
          btn.addEventListener("click", revealCart);
        });

        function fmt(cents) {
          var dollars = Math.floor(cents / 100);
          var rem = cents % 100;
          var d = String(dollars).replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, ",");
          return rem === 0 ? "$" + d : "$" + d + "." + (rem < 10 ? "0" + rem : String(rem));
        }
        function clampQty(v) {
          v = parseInt(v, 10);
          if (isNaN(v) || v < 1) return 1;
          if (v > 99) return 99;
          return v;
        }
        function totalItems() {
          var n = 0;
          ORDER.forEach(function (k) { if (cart[k]) n += cart[k]; });
          return n;
        }
        function grandCents() {
          var t = 0;
          ORDER.forEach(function (k) { if (cart[k]) t += cart[k] * PRODUCTS[k].cents; });
          return t;
        }

        function renderCart() {
          var n = totalItems();
          if (countEl) {
            countEl.textContent = String(n);
            countEl.hidden = n === 0;
          }
          // Both cart pills: count + running total always stay
          // current, but VISIBILITY belongs to the cart pill gate
          // alone (see cartRevealed above) — never to the cart
          // contents.
          if (floatEl) {
            applyFloatGate();
            if (floatCountEl) {
              floatCountEl.textContent = String(n);
              floatCountEl.hidden = n === 0;
            }
            if (floatTotalEl) floatTotalEl.textContent = fmt(grandCents());
          }
          linesEl.innerHTML = "";
          ORDER.forEach(function (k) {
            var qty = cart[k];
            if (!qty) return;
            var p = PRODUCTS[k];
            var line = document.createElement("div");
            line.className = "cart-line";

            var top = document.createElement("div");
            top.className = "cart-line-top";
            var name = document.createElement("span");
            name.className = "cart-line-name";
            name.textContent = p.name;
            var total = document.createElement("span");
            total.className = "cart-line-total";
            total.textContent = fmt(p.cents * qty);
            top.appendChild(name);
            top.appendChild(total);
            line.appendChild(top);

            var sub = document.createElement("div");
            sub.className = "cart-line-sub";
            sub.textContent = fmt(p.cents) + " each";
            line.appendChild(sub);

            var controls = document.createElement("div");
            controls.className = "cart-line-controls";
            var box = document.createElement("div");
            box.className = "qty-box sm";
            var dec = document.createElement("button");
            dec.type = "button";
            dec.className = "qty-btn";
            dec.textContent = "−";
            dec.setAttribute("aria-label", "Decrease quantity — " + p.name);
            dec.addEventListener("click", function () { setQty(k, qty - 1); });
            var input = document.createElement("input");
            input.className = "qty-input";
            input.type = "number";
            input.inputMode = "numeric";
            input.min = "1";
            input.max = "99";
            input.value = String(qty);
            input.setAttribute("aria-label", "Quantity — " + p.name);
            input.addEventListener("change", function () { setQty(k, clampQty(input.value)); });
            var inc = document.createElement("button");
            inc.type = "button";
            inc.className = "qty-btn";
            inc.textContent = "+";
            inc.setAttribute("aria-label", "Increase quantity — " + p.name);
            inc.addEventListener("click", function () { setQty(k, qty + 1); });
            box.appendChild(dec);
            box.appendChild(input);
            box.appendChild(inc);
            controls.appendChild(box);

            var remove = document.createElement("button");
            remove.type = "button";
            remove.className = "cart-remove";
            remove.textContent = "Remove";
            remove.setAttribute("aria-label", "Remove " + p.name + " from cart");
            remove.addEventListener("click", function () {
              delete cart[k];
              renderCart();
            });
            controls.appendChild(remove);
            line.appendChild(controls);

            linesEl.appendChild(line);
          });
          if (emptyEl) emptyEl.style.display = n === 0 ? "" : "none";
          if (totalRowEl) totalRowEl.hidden = n === 0;
          grandEl.textContent = fmt(grandCents());
          refreshSends();
        }

        function setQty(k, qty) {
          qty = clampQty(qty);
          cart[k] = qty;
          renderCart();
        }

        // Row quantity steppers (in each kit card)
        document.querySelectorAll("[data-qty-inc]").forEach(function (btn) {
          btn.addEventListener("click", function () {
            var input = document.getElementById(btn.getAttribute("data-qty-inc"));
            if (input) input.value = String(clampQty(clampQty(input.value) + 1));
          });
        });
        document.querySelectorAll("[data-qty-dec]").forEach(function (btn) {
          btn.addEventListener("click", function () {
            var input = document.getElementById(btn.getAttribute("data-qty-dec"));
            if (input) input.value = String(clampQty(clampQty(input.value) - 1));
          });
        });
        document.querySelectorAll(".buy-row .qty-input").forEach(function (input) {
          input.addEventListener("change", function () { input.value = String(clampQty(input.value)); });
        });

        // ADD TO CART — accumulates; same product increases its line's qty
        document.querySelectorAll("[data-add]").forEach(function (btn) {
          var label = btn.textContent;
          var timer = null;
          btn.addEventListener("click", function () {
            var key = btn.getAttribute("data-add");
            var input = document.getElementById(btn.getAttribute("data-qty"));
            var qty = input ? clampQty(input.value) : 1;
            cart[key] = (cart[key] || 0) + qty;
            if (cart[key] > 99) cart[key] = 99;
            renderCart();
            // Pulse the floating pill so the add visibly registers,
            // wherever on the page the visitor tapped ADD TO CART.
            if (floatEl) {
              floatEl.classList.remove("pulse");
              void floatEl.offsetWidth;
              floatEl.classList.add("pulse");
            }
            btn.textContent = "ADDED ✓";
            btn.classList.add("added");
            if (timer) clearTimeout(timer);
            timer = setTimeout(function () {
              btn.textContent = label;
              btn.classList.remove("added");
            }, 1400);
          });
        });

        // CHECKOUT — the finalize step: opens the buyer-details
        // panel. Its SEND (composed by refreshSends below) opens the
        // visitor's email app addressed to the sales inbox with the
        // buyer details + cart, registering purchase interest. No
        // payment is taken, nothing is charged, no order is placed.
        var finalizePanel = document.getElementById("finalizePanel");
        if (checkoutBtn && finalizePanel) {
          checkoutBtn.addEventListener("click", function () {
            var open = finalizePanel.classList.toggle("open");
            checkoutBtn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", String(open));
            if (open) {
              refreshSends();
              finalizePanel.scrollIntoView({ block: "nearest", behavior: "smooth" });
            }
          });
        }

        // REQUEST A QUOTE — opens the quote panel with the current
        // cart contents listed above a short form; SEND opens the
        // visitor's email app addressed to the sales inbox with the
        // fields + cart lines, and the team prepares the quote.
        var quoteBtn = document.getElementById("cartQuoteBtn");
        var quotePanel = document.getElementById("quotePanel");
        var quoteSummary = document.getElementById("quoteSummary");
        function cartLinesText() {
          var lines = [];
          ORDER.forEach(function (k) {
            if (cart[k]) lines.push(PRODUCTS[k].name + " × " + cart[k] + " = " + fmt(PRODUCTS[k].cents * cart[k]));
          });
          return lines;
        }
        function refreshQuoteSummary() {
          if (!quoteSummary) return;
          var lines = cartLinesText();
          quoteSummary.textContent = lines.length
            ? lines.join("\n") + "\nGrand total: " + fmt(grandCents())
            : "Your cart is empty — add a kit above and your quote will list it here.";
        }
        if (quoteBtn && quotePanel) {
          quoteBtn.addEventListener("click", function () {
            var open = quotePanel.classList.toggle("open");
            quoteBtn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", String(open));
            if (open) {
              refreshQuoteSummary();
              refreshSends();
              quotePanel.scrollIntoView({ block: "nearest", behavior: "smooth" });
            }
          });
        }

        // SEND ACTIONS — the Quote and Finalize send buttons compose
        // a mailto in the visitor's own email app, addressed to the
        // sales inbox. The quote's subject carries the form fields +
        // cart lines + total; finalize registers purchase interest
        // under "Purchase Interest — <name> — <total>". Both bodies
        // carry the fields and the full cart. The page itself sends
        // and saves nothing on its own. refreshSends keeps the two
        // panels' cart summaries current on every cart render and
        // every keystroke, so the lines a visitor sees always match
        // the cart in front of them.
        function refreshSends() {
          refreshQuoteSummary();
          var lines = cartLinesText();
          var fSummary = document.getElementById("finalizeSummary");
          if (fSummary) {
            fSummary.textContent = lines.length
              ? lines.join("\n") + "\nGrand total: " + fmt(grandCents())
              : "Your cart is empty — add a kit above first; you can still send your interest and the team will follow up.";
          }
        }
        function fieldVal(id) {
          var el = document.getElementById(id);
          return el ? el.value.trim() : "";
        }
        function fieldLines(pairs) {
          var lines = [];
          pairs.forEach(function (p) {
            var v = fieldVal(p[1]);
            if (v) lines.push(p[0] + ": " + v);
          });
          return lines;
        }
        var quoteSendBtn = document.getElementById("quoteSend");
        if (quoteSendBtn) quoteSendBtn.addEventListener("click", function () {
          var fields = fieldLines([["Name", "qName"], ["School / Organization", "qOrg"], ["Email", "qEmail"], ["Phone", "qPhone"], ["Notes", "qNotes"]]);
          var cl = cartLinesText();
          var subjectParts = ["Sourccey Quote Request"].concat(fields);
          if (cl.length) subjectParts = subjectParts.concat(cl, ["Grand total: " + fmt(grandCents())]);
          var body = fields.slice();
          if (cl.length) { body.push(""); body.push("Cart:"); body = body.concat(cl); body.push("Grand total: " + fmt(grandCents())); }
          var a = document.createElement("a");
          a.href = "mailto:Taylorsalesourccey@gmail.com?subject=" + encodeURIComponent(subjectParts.join(" — ")) + "&body=" + encodeURIComponent(body.join("\n"));
          document.body.appendChild(a);
          a.click();
          a.remove();
        });
        var finalizeSendBtn = document.getElementById("finalizeSend");
        if (finalizeSendBtn) finalizeSendBtn.addEventListener("click", function () {
          var name = fieldVal("finName");
          var total = fmt(grandCents());
          var subject = "Purchase Interest — " + (name ? name + " — " : "") + total;
          var body = fieldLines([["Name", "finName"], ["School / Organization", "finOrg"], ["Email", "finEmail"], ["Phone", "finPhone"]]);
          var cl = cartLinesText();
          if (cl.length) { body.push(""); body.push("Cart:"); body = body.concat(cl); body.push("Grand total: " + total); }
          var a = document.createElement("a");
          a.href = "mailto:Taylorsalesourccey@gmail.com?subject=" + encodeURIComponent(subject) + "&body=" + encodeURIComponent(body.join("\n"));
          document.body.appendChild(a);
          a.click();
          a.remove();
        });
        ["qName", "qOrg", "qEmail", "qPhone", "qNotes", "finName", "finOrg", "finEmail", "finPhone"].forEach(function (id) {
          var el = document.getElementById(id);
          if (el) el.addEventListener("input", refreshSends);
        });
        // View-state keeper hook: the cart contents are part of the
        // view state — a shell reload restores them exactly (the float
        // gate still owns pill visibility; restoring contents never
        // reveals the pill on its own).
        if (window.SV) SV.registerCart(
          function () {
            var o = {};
            ORDER.forEach(function (k) { if (cart[k]) o[k] = cart[k]; });
            return o;
          },
          function (obj) {
            cart = {};
            if (obj) ORDER.forEach(function (k) {
              var q = parseInt(obj[k], 10);
              if (q > 0) cart[k] = Math.min(99, q);
            });
            renderCart();
          }
        );

        renderCart();
      })();
    </script>
    <script>
      (function () {
        // CONTACT FORMS — Enroll, Demo, and Member are static panels.
        // Tapping a form's SEND button composes a mailto in the
        // visitor's own email app, addressed to the sales inbox with

            });

            document.body.appendChild(a);

          });

      })();

    <script>
      (function () {
        // ADMIN ONE-PAGER — PRINT: the browser print call is dead
        // inside the sandboxed share-wrapper iframe (verified on iPhone — the tap
        // did nothing), so PRINT now uses the SAME proven PDF handoff
        // as SHARE's fallback below: the bundled one-pager PDF opens
        // full-screen in a new tab, and the visitor prints from the PDF
        // viewer itself (iOS: Share → Print in the PDF view; desktop:
        // the viewer's print control). The @media print stylesheet
        // (#print-onepager) remains only as a dormant enhancement for
        // printing the page itself — it is not the mechanism here.
        var btn = document.getElementById("adminPrintBtn");
        if (btn) {
          btn.addEventListener("click", function () {
            try { window.open("data:application/octet-stream;base64,", "_blank"); } catch (e) {}
          });
        }

        // ADMIN ONE-PAGER — SHARE: one tap shares the actual document —
        // the bundled one-pager PDF (data:application/octet-stream;base64,)
        // through the native share sheet via the Web Share API with
        // files, where the device supports it. Where file sharing is
        // unavailable or blocked, fall back to opening the PDF
        // full-screen so it can be sent or saved from there. No form,
        // no typing — the file itself is what moves.
        var shareBtn = document.getElementById("adminShareBtn");
        if (shareBtn) {
          shareBtn.addEventListener("click", function () {
            var pdfUrl = "data:application/octet-stream;base64,";
            function openFallback() {
              try { window.open(pdfUrl, "_blank"); } catch (e) {}
            }
            if (!navigator.share) { openFallback(); return; }
            fetch(pdfUrl).then(function (res) {
              if (!res.ok) throw new Error("fetch failed");
              return res.blob();
            }).then(function (blob) {
              var file = new File([blob], "sourccey-admin-one-pager.pdf", { type: "application/pdf" });
              var data = { files: [file] };
              if (navigator.canShare && navigator.canShare(data)) {
                navigator.share(data).catch(function (err) {
                  // A dismissed share sheet (AbortError) is a choice,
                  // not a failure — only fall back on a real block.
                  if (err && err.name !== "AbortError") openFallback();
                });
              } else {
                openFallback();
              }
            }).catch(openFallback);
          });
        }

        // ADMIN ONE-PAGER — "MORE FOR ADMINISTRATORS" collapsible bar:
        // collapsed by default when the sheet opens; tapping the bar
        // expands the three document pills and tapping again collapses
        // them (the panel's grid-rows animation lives in the CSS).
        // Pure in-memory UI state — nothing persists between opens.
        var moreBar = document.getElementById("adminMoreBar");
        var morePanel = document.getElementById("adminMorePanel");
        if (moreBar && morePanel) {
          moreBar.addEventListener("click", function () {
            var open = morePanel.classList.toggle("open");

    <script>
      (function () {
        // HERO MENU (☰, standing alone at the top-right) — a
        // shortcut list in the page's neon style. Opening it takes
        // the shared page scroll lock; closing (toggle, tap-outside,
        // Escape, or picking a shortcut) restores scroll exactly via
        // the shared unlock. A shortcut tap closes the menu, then
        // lands on its destination: collapsed bars/sections are
        // expanded FIRST (by firing their own toggle, so every side
        // effect — aria state, the cart-pill gate — matches a real
        // tap), then the page smooth-scrolls to the now-open content.
        // Join Discord is a plain link with the hero pill's exact
        // href/target — the same invite behavior as the pill itself.
        var trigger = document.getElementById("menuTrigger");
        var menu = document.getElementById("heroMenu");
        if (!trigger || !menu) return;
        var menuOpen = false;

        function openMenu() {
          if (menuOpen) return;
          menuOpen = true;
          menu.hidden = false;
          trigger.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "true");
          lockPageScroll();
        }
        function closeMenu() {
          if (!menuOpen) return;
          menuOpen = false;
          menu.hidden = true;
          trigger.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
          unlockPageScroll();
        }
        trigger.addEventListener("click", function () {
          if (menuOpen) closeMenu(); else openMenu();
        });
        document.addEventListener("pointerdown", function (ev) {
          if (!menuOpen) return;
          if (menu.contains(ev.target) || trigger.contains(ev.target)) return;
          closeMenu();
        });
        document.addEventListener("keydown", function (ev) {
          if (menuOpen && (ev.key === "Escape" || ev.key === "Esc")) closeMenu();
        });

        function scrollToEl(el) {
          if (!el) return;
          // The target may still be animating open (grid-rows
          // transition); scroll once now and again as it settles.
          el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" });
          setTimeout(function () { el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" }); }, 420);
        }
        function expandThenScroll(btn, panel, scrollEl) {
          if (btn && panel && !panel.classList.contains("open")) btn.click();
          scrollToEl(scrollEl || btn);
        }

        var dests = {
          enroll: function () {
            expandThenScroll(document.getElementById("enrollNowBtn"), document.getElementById("enrollPanel"));
          },
          demo: function () {
            expandThenScroll(document.getElementById("requestDemoBtn"), document.getElementById("demoPanel"));
          },
          curriculum: function () {
            var b = document.querySelector('[data-open="sheet-curriculum"]');
            if (b) b.click();
          },
          purchase: function () {
            var t = document.getElementById("purchaseToggle");
            var r = document.getElementById("purchaseRegion");
            if (t && r && !r.classList.contains("open")) t.click();
            scrollToEl(t);
          },
          member: function () {
            var acc = document.querySelector(".member-acc");
            if (!acc) return;
            var item = acc.querySelector(".acc-item");
            var btn = acc.querySelector(".acc-btn");
            if (item && btn && !item.classList.contains("open")) btn.click();
            scrollToEl(acc);
          },
          plushie: function () {
            var row = document.querySelector(".plushie-row");
            var b = document.querySelector('.plushie-pill[data-open="sheet-plushie"]');
            if (b) b.click();
            scrollToEl(row);
          },
          faqs: function () {
            var t = document.getElementById("classesToggle");
            var r = document.getElementById("classesRegion");
            if (t && r && !r.classList.contains("open")) t.click();
            scrollToEl(t);
          }
        };
        menu.querySelectorAll("[data-menu-go]").forEach(function (item) {
          item.addEventListener("click", function () {
            var go = dests[item.getAttribute("data-menu-go")];
            closeMenu();
            if (go) go();
          });
        });
        // The Join Discord link keeps its native behavior; the menu
        // just closes behind it.
        var discordItem = menu.querySelector('a.menu-item[href*="discord.com/invite"]');
        if (discordItem) discordItem.addEventListener("click", closeMenu);
      })();
    </script>
    <script>
      (function () {
        // ASK SOURCCEY — spinning rainbow-dot sphere (original canvas
        // animation) + verified-facts knowledge chat. No network calls;
        // answers come only from the facts below.
        var reduced = false;
        try { reduced = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches; } catch (e) {}

        // ---- Sphere: rainbow dots distributed on a ball (Fibonacci
        // sphere), rotating around a tilted axis. Each dot keeps the hue
        // of its home position, so the rainbow pattern travels with the
        // spin. Back dots draw dimmer for depth.
        function makeSphere(canvas) {
          if (!canvas) return null;
          var ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
          if (!ctx) return null;
          var W = canvas.width, H = canvas.height;
          var cx = W / 2, cy = H / 2, R = Math.min(W, H) / 2 - 3;
          var N = 170, pts = [];
          var golden = Math.PI * (3 - Math.sqrt(5));
          for (var i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            var y = 1 - (i / (N - 1)) * 2;
            var rad = Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, 1 - y * y));
            var theta = golden * i;
            var x = Math.cos(theta) * rad, z = Math.sin(theta) * rad;
            var hue = ((Math.atan2(z, x) * 180 / Math.PI) + 360 + y * 60) % 360;
            pts.push({ x: x, y: y, z: z, hue: hue });
          }
          var tilt = 0.42, ct = Math.cos(tilt), st = Math.sin(tilt);
          function draw(angle) {
            ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
            var ca = Math.cos(angle), sa = Math.sin(angle);
            var proj = [];
            for (var i = 0; i < pts.length; i++) {
              var p = pts[i];
              // rotate around Y
              var x1 = p.x * ca + p.z * sa;
              var z1 = -p.x * sa + p.z * ca;
              // tilt around X
              var y2 = p.y * ct - z1 * st;
              var z2 = p.y * st + z1 * ct;
              proj.push({ sx: cx + x1 * R, sy: cy + y2 * R, z: z2, hue: p.hue });
            }
            proj.sort(function (a, b) { return a.z - b.z; });
            for (var j = 0; j < proj.length; j++) {
              var q = proj[j];
              var depth = (q.z + 1) / 2; // 0 back, 1 front
              var r = 1.1 + depth * (W > 60 ? 2.1 : 1.9);
              var light = 42 + depth * 22;
              var alpha = 0.35 + depth * 0.65;
              ctx.beginPath();
              ctx.arc(q.sx, q.sy, r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
              ctx.fillStyle = "hsla(" + q.hue + ", 95%, " + light + "%, " + alpha + ")";
              ctx.fill();
            }
          }
          draw(0.6);
          return { draw: draw };
        }
        var sphereA = makeSphere(document.getElementById("askSphereLauncher"));
        var sphereB = makeSphere(document.getElementById("askSpherePanel"));
        if (!reduced && (sphereA || sphereB)) {
          // Animate only what is actually on screen, at half rate. The
          // old loop redrew BOTH spheres at a full 60fps forever — the
          // panel sphere's canvas sits inside the hidden chat panel, and
          // the launcher sphere keeps spinning even under a full-screen
          // sheet. That constant, never-idle load is what made phones
          // give up on the page mid-browse and reload it back to the
          // top on their own. Drawing only the visible sphere, at
          // ~30fps, and nothing while the page is hidden keeps the
          // page — and the visitor's place on it — alive.
          var askPanelEl = document.getElementById("askPanel");
          var start = null;
          var lastDraw = 0;
          function tick(ts) {
            requestAnimationFrame(tick);
            if (document.hidden) return;
            if (start === null) start = ts;
            if (ts - lastDraw < 33) return;
            lastDraw = ts;
            var angle = ((ts - start) / 1000) * 0.9;
            var panelOpen = askPanelEl && !askPanelEl.hidden;
            var sheetOpen = !!document.querySelector(".sheet-overlay.show");
            if (sphereB && panelOpen) sphereB.draw(angle);
            if (sphereA && !panelOpen && !sheetOpen) sphereA.draw(angle);
          }
          requestAnimationFrame(tick);
        }

        // ---- Chat brain: the full Ask Sourccey knowledge base, distilled
        // in-page (program record + Vulcan's sites, GitHub, the 163-page
        // manual, the kit BOM, YouTube/Discord). Answers come ONLY from
        // these entries. Hard rules run first: fuse = confirmed
        // kit spec (top 15A blue / bottom 10A red, Manual Stage 5 p.73);
        // torque = confirmed servo spec (2× 50 kg·cm STS3250 +
        // 30 kg·cm STS3215 per arm); no cycle-life number; no ship/launch
        // dates; no stock claims; PUFF price only as in the store entry
        // below; never "certification." ----
        var DISCORD = "https://discord.com/invite/wcxDdcMXhM";
        var DISCORDLINK = "<a href=\"" + DISCORD + "\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener\">Join the Sourccey Discord</a>";
        var FALLBACK = "Not in my head — and I don&rsquo;t bluff. I don&rsquo;t have that answer — please contact Taylorsalesourccey@gmail.com.";
        // ---- SUPPORT SPECIALIST layer — when a question is a help,

          { id: "currSafety", k: ["safety rules", "curriculum safety", "safety and care", "care rules", "care of the machine", "two-person lift", "two person lift", "lift the robot", "move the robot", "adhesives", "glue on", "headset safety", "spotter"],
            a: "My curriculum&rsquo;s <strong>five Safety &amp; Care rules</strong> — stated in Lesson 1, posted in the room, enforced every session: <strong>1.
