        var KIT_TOPICS = { prices: 1, vulcanPrice: 1, partPrices: 1, partsCosting: 1, included: 1, makerBox: 1, completeSpecs: 1, builtCase: 1, makerPrint: 1, packingMaps: 1, checkout: 1, cartQuote: 1 };
        var NUMW = { one: 1, two: 2, three: 3, four: 4, five: 5, six: 6, seven: 7, eight: 8, nine: 9, ten: 10, eleven: 11, twelve: 12, dozen: 12, thirteen: 13, fourteen: 14, fifteen: 15, sixteen: 16, seventeen: 17, eighteen: 18, nineteen: 19, twenty: 20, thirty: 30, forty: 40, fifty: 50 };
        function fmt(n) {
          var s = n.toFixed(2).replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, ",");
          return "$" + (s.slice(-3) === ".00" ? s.slice(0, -3) : s);
        }
        function kitInText(toks) {
          for (var i = 0; i < toks.length; i++) {
            if (toks[i] === "maker") return "maker";
            if (toks[i] === "complete") return "complete";
            if (toks[i] === "built") return "built";
            if (toks[i] === "plushie" || toks[i] === "plushies" || toks[i] === "plush") return "plushie";
          }
          return null;
        }
        function kitAnswer(k, kind) {
          var K = KITS[k];
          if (kind === "price") return "The <strong>" + K.name + "</strong> is <strong>" + K.priceDisp + "</strong> — " + K.blurb;
          if (kind === "build") return "<strong>" + K.name + "</strong> — who builds it? " + K.build + ".";
          return K.inc;
        }
        function compareKits(a, b) {
          var A = KITS[a], B = KITS[b];
          var diff = Math.abs(A.price - B.price);
          var diffTxt = diff > 0 ? " That&rsquo;s a <strong>" + fmt(diff) + "</strong> difference — the <strong>" + (A.price < B.price ? A.name : B.name) + "</strong> is the cheaper of the two." : "";
          return "<strong>" + A.name + " vs " + B.name + "</strong> — same robot, same 163-page manual, same 14 lessons. What changes is who prints the body — and whether anyone builds at all.<br>" +
            "<strong>Price:</strong> " + A.name + " <strong>" + A.priceDisp + "</strong> · " + B.name + " <strong>" + B.priceDisp + "</strong>." + diffTxt + "<br>" +
            "<strong>Printed parts:</strong> " + A.name + " — " + A.prints + ". " + B.name + " — " + B.prints + ".<br>" +
            "<strong>The build:</strong> " + A.name + " — " + A.build + ". " + B.name + " — " + B.build + ".<br>" +
            "<strong>In the box:</strong> " + A.incShort + " " + B.incShort;
        }
        function noteCtx(entry, toks) {
          var k = kitInText(toks || []);
          if (k) CTX.kit = k;
          if (!entry) return;
          CTX.topic = entry.id;
          if (entry.id === "prices" || entry.id === "vulcanPrice" || entry.id === "partPrices") CTX.kind = "price";
          else if (entry.id === "included" || entry.id === "makerBox" || entry.id === "completeSpecs" || entry.id === "builtCase") CTX.kind = "inc";
          if (!k && !KIT_TOPICS[entry.id]) { CTX.kit = null; CTX.kind = null; }
          if (entry.id.indexOf("ts") === 0) CTX.trouble = entry.id;
          else CTX.trouble = null;
        }
        function answerFor(raw) {
          var q = " " + String(raw || "").toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, " ") + " ";
          // Misspellings of the name itself (sourcey, sorcey, sourccy,
          // a garbled tail like "sourceyb"…) normalize to "sourccey"
          // before any matching, so a mistyped name can never sink an
          // otherwise-matching question. Guarded: real words that merely
          // resemble the name ("source", "sorcery", "course") never map.
          var NAME_VARIANTS = { sourcey: 1, sorcey: 1, sourccy: 1, sourcy: 1, soucey: 1, sourcce: 1, soursey: 1, sorccy: 1, sourkey: 1 };
          function lev(a, b) {
            var m = [], i, j;
            for (i = 0; i <= a.length; i++) { m.push([i]); }
            for (j = 0; j <= b.length; j++) { m[0][j] = j; }
            for (i = 1; i <= a.length; i++) {
              for (j = 1; j <= b.length; j++) {
                m[i][j] = Math.min(m[i - 1][j] + 1, m[i][j - 1] + 1, m[i - 1][j - 1] + (a.charAt(i - 1) === b.charAt(j - 1) ? 0 : 1));
              }
            }
            return m[a.length][b.length];
          }
          function fixName(t) {
            if (t === "sourccey" || t.length < 5) return t;
            if (NAME_VARIANTS[t]) return "sourccey";
            if (t.indexOf("sourcey") === 0 || t.indexOf("sorcey") === 0 || t.indexOf("sourccy") === 0) return "sourccey";
            if (t.indexOf("source") === 0 || t === "sorcery") return t;
            if (t.length >= 6 && lev(t, "sourccey") <= 2) return "sourccey";
            return t;
          }
          q = q.split(" ").map(fixName).join(" ");
          function has() {
            for (var i = 0; i < arguments.length; i++) {
              if (q.indexOf(" " + arguments[i] + " ") !== -1) return true;
            }
            return false;
          }
          // ---- Hard rules first (never-surface list) ----
          // Safety escalation outranks every other fence: any sign of
          // damage, heat, smell, swelling, or sparking is a full stop —
          // power off, no charging, no continuing, contact the team.
          if (has("swollen", "swelling", "bulging", "punctured", "sparking", "sparked", "sparks", "smoke", "smoking", "melting", "leaking", "on fire", "cracked", "damaged", "smell", "smells", "smelly", "odor", "odour", "burning smell", "burnt smell", "too hot", "getting hot", "really hot", "very hot", "feels hot", "hot to the touch", "overheating", "overheated")) return SAFETY_STOP;
          if (has("home address")) return FALLBACK;
          if (has("fuse", "fuses")) return FUSE_ANSWER;
          // Never route around a fuse, the battery, or the manual:
          // bypass and modification asks get a straight refusal.
          if (has("bypass", "without a fuse", "bigger fuse", "larger fuse", "modify the battery", "mod the battery", "open the battery", "open up the battery", "battery mod", "jumper the fuse", "foil the fuse")) return NO_BYPASS;
          if (has("puff")) return PUFF_ANSWER;
          if (has("cycle", "cycles", "cycle life", "lifespan", "how long does the battery last", "how long will the battery last", "battery life", "battery lifespan")) return CYCLE_ANSWER;
          if (has("torque")) return TORQUE_ANSWER;
          if (has("ship", "ships", "shipping", "shipped", "launch", "launches", "launching", "release date", "when does it come out", "when can i buy", "delivery date", "deliver", "arrive", "when will i get")) return SHIP_ANSWER;
          if (has("in stock", "stock", "sold out", "backorder", "backordered", "availability", "available now", "restock", "restocking")) return STOCK_ANSWER;
          if (has("warranty", "guarantee", "return policy", "refund policy", "replacement policy")) {
            return "No warranty, returns, or replacement policy is published in any source I have, so I won&rsquo;t invent one — not my style. For anything like that, ask the team on Discord: " + DISCORDLINK + ".";
          }
          // Support-terms questions route to the support-model entry,
          // which states what help exists — and, plainly, that response
          // times, training beyond the one day, and a replacement-parts
          // policy are not published terms and are not promised.
          if (has("response time", "response times", "how fast do you respond", "how quickly do you respond", "how long do you take to respond", "how long to hear back", "support hours", "phone support", "extra training", "additional training", "more training days", "another training day", "second training day")) return KB_BY_ID.supportModel;
          if (has("certification", "certified", "certificate")) return KB_BY_ID.stamp;
          // Quest/VR is a standing denial, never a drive mode: any
          // question that mentions it routes to the Quest answer before
          // scored matching, so the widened drive cues on the teleop
          // topic can never outscore or hijack it.
          if (has("quest", "oculus", "meta quest", "vr headset")) return KB_BY_ID.quest;
          // ---- Matching machinery (exact + fuzzy) ----
          // Word-boundary matching: the question is already normalized to
          // space-separated tokens, and a cue matches only whole tokens —
          // a token may differ from a cue word only by a trailing plural
          // "s" — so a short cue like "api" can never fire inside an
          // unrelated word like "capital", while "camera"/"cameras" and
          // "kit"/"kits" still pair up. A cue scores its content-word
          // count: question-frame words (the, is, tell me about…) carry
          // no topic weight, so a specific topic cue ("api") outranks a
          // generic opener phrase ("tell me about").
          var FRAME_W = { a: 1, an: 1, the: 1, is: 1, are: 1, was: 1, were: 1, do: 1, does: 1, did: 1, it: 1, its: 1, i: 1, you: 1, we: 1, me: 1, my: 1, your: 1, of: 1, in: 1, on: 1, at: 1, to: 1, for: 1, with: 1, and: 1, or: 1, s: 1, tell: 1, about: 1 };
          var qTokens = q.split(" ").filter(function (t) { return t.length > 0; });
          function tokenEq(tok, word) { return tok === word || tok === word + "s" || tok + "s" === word; }
          function cueTokens(cue) {
            return cue.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, " ").split(" ").filter(function (t) { return t.length > 0; });
          }
          function cueHit(ct, toks) {
            if (ct.length === 1) {
              for (var t = 0; t < toks.length; t++) if (tokenEq(toks[t], ct[0])) return true;
              return false;
            }
            for (var s0 = 0; s0 + ct.length <= toks.length; s0++) {
              var ok = true;
              for (var w = 0; w < ct.length; w++) if (!tokenEq(toks[s0 + w], ct[w])) { ok = false; break; }
              if (ok) return true;
            }
            return false;
          }
          function cueScore(ct) {
            var content = 0;
            for (var w = 0; w < ct.length; w++) if (!FRAME_W[ct[w]]) content++;
            return content > 0 ? content : 0.5;
          }
          // A singular/plural cue pair ("camera"/"cameras") describes one
          // topic word — count it once per entry, not once per form.
          function cueBase(word) {
            if (/es$/.test(word) && word.length > 3) return word.slice(0, -2);
            if (/s$/.test(word)) return word.slice(0, -1);
            return word;
          }
          // Fuzzy layer: synonyms, word forms, and small typos earn a
          // discounted score instead of a miss. The fenced words are
          // excluded outright — fuzz never routes around a hard rule,
          // and the fence topics themselves only ever answer through
          // the exact rules above (or a did-you-mean tap).
          var FENCE_W = { fuse: 1, fuses: 1, ship: 1, ships: 1, shipping: 1, shipped: 1, stock: 1, cycle: 1, cycles: 1, quest: 1, oculus: 1, warranty: 1 };
          var SYN_GROUPS = [
            ["price", "cost", "costs", "pricing", "run"],
            ["buy", "order", "purchase", "get"],
            ["big", "tall", "large"],
            ["weigh", "heavy"],
            ["picture", "photo", "pictures", "photos"]
          ];
          function synEq(a, b) {
            if (a === b) return true;
            for (var g = 0; g < SYN_GROUPS.length; g++) {
              if (SYN_GROUPS[g].indexOf(a) !== -1 && SYN_GROUPS[g].indexOf(b) !== -1) return true;
            }
            return false;
          }
          function stemOf(w) {
            if (w.length < 5) return "";
            return w.replace(/(ing|ed|es|s)$/, "");
          }
          function wordWeight(tok, word) {
            if (FENCE_W[word]) return 0;
            if (tokenEq(tok, word)) return 1;
            if (synEq(tok, word)) return 0.8;
            var st = stemOf(tok), sw = stemOf(word);
            if (st && sw && st === sw) return 0.8;
            if (tok.length >= 5 && word.length >= 5 && lev(tok, word) <= 1) return 0.6;
            if (tok.length >= 9 && word.length >= 9 && lev(tok, word) <= 2) return 0.6;
            return 0;
          }
          function cueHitFuzzy(ct, toks) {
            if (ct.length === 1) {
              var b = 0;
              for (var t = 0; t < toks.length; t++) { var w1 = wordWeight(toks[t], ct[0]); if (w1 > b) b = w1; }
              return b;
            }
            var bestAvg = 0;
            for (var s0 = 0; s0 + ct.length <= toks.length; s0++) {
              var sum = 0, ok = true;
              for (var w2 = 0; w2 < ct.length; w2++) {
                var ww = wordWeight(toks[s0 + w2], ct[w2]);
                if (ww < 0.6) { ok = false; break; }
                sum += ww;
              }
              if (ok) { var avg = sum / ct.length; if (avg > bestAvg) bestAvg = avg; }
            }
            return bestAvg;
          }
          function scoreEntry(entry, toks, fuzzy) {
            var score = 0, seenBase = {};
            for (var j = 0; j < entry.k.length; j++) {
              var ct = cueTokens(entry.k[j]);
              if (!ct.length) continue;
              if (!fuzzy) {
                if (!cueHit(ct, toks)) continue;
                if (ct.length === 1) { var base = cueBase(ct[0]); if (seenBase[base]) continue; seenBase[base] = 1; }
                score += cueScore(ct);
              } else {
                var wgt = cueHitFuzzy(ct, toks);
                if (wgt <= 0) continue;
                if (ct.length === 1) { var base2 = cueBase(ct[0]); if (seenBase[base2]) continue; seenBase[base2] = 1; }
                score += cueScore(ct) * wgt;
              }
            }
            return score;
          }
          function bestMatch(toks, fuzzy) {
            var bE = null, bS = 0;
            for (var i = 0; i < KB.length; i++) {
              var s = scoreEntry(KB[i], toks, fuzzy);
              if (s > bS) { bS = s; bE = KB[i]; }
            }
            return { entry: bE, score: bS };
          }
          function hasTok(toks, w) { return toks.indexOf(w) !== -1; }
          // ---- Kit math: "3 Maker kits for my school" ----
          function kitMath(toks) {
            var kit = kitInText(toks);
            if (!kit) return null;
            var ki = -1, ni = -1, n = null;
            for (var i = 0; i < toks.length; i++) {
              if (toks[i] === "maker" || toks[i] === "complete" || toks[i] === "built" || toks[i] === "plushie" || toks[i] === "plushies" || toks[i] === "plush") { ki = i; break; }
            }
            for (var j = 0; j < toks.length; j++) {
              if (/^\d{1,4}$/.test(toks[j])) { n = parseInt(toks[j], 10); ni = j; break; }
              if (NUMW[toks[j]]) { n = NUMW[toks[j]]; ni = j; break; }
              if (toks[j] === "couple" || toks[j] === "pair") { n = 2; ni = j; break; }
            }
            if (n === null || ni < 0 || ki < 0 || Math.abs(ni - ki) > 3 || n < 2 || n > 500) return null;
            var framed = hasTok(toks, "kits") || hasTok(toks, "plushies") || hasTok(toks, "how") || hasTok(toks, "buy") || hasTok(toks, "order") || hasTok(toks, "need") || hasTok(toks, "want") || hasTok(toks, "get");
            if (!framed) return null;
            var K = KITS[kit];
            CTX.kit = kit; CTX.kind = "price"; CTX.topic = "kit:" + kit; CTX.qty = n;
            return "<strong>" + n + " × " + K.name + "</strong> at " + K.priceDisp + " each = <strong>" + fmt(n * K.price) + "</strong>. Set the quantity on the kit&rsquo;s card right on this page and tap ADD TO CART — the cart pill keeps the running total, and CHECKOUT sends it to the team. No payment is taken here.";
          }
          // ---- Comparisons: "Maker vs Complete" ----
          function kitCompare(toks) {
            var found = [];
            for (var i = 0; i < toks.length; i++) {
              var kk = toks[i] === "maker" ? "maker" : toks[i] === "complete" ? "complete" : toks[i] === "built" ? "built" : null;
              if (kk && found.indexOf(kk) === -1) found.push(kk);
            }
            if (found.length < 2) return null;
            var marker = hasTok(toks, "vs") || hasTok(toks, "versus") || hasTok(toks, "compare") || hasTok(toks, "comparison") || hasTok(toks, "difference") || hasTok(toks, "differ") || hasTok(toks, "differs") || (hasTok(toks, "which") && hasTok(toks, "or")) || (hasTok(toks, "or") && (hasTok(toks, "better") || hasTok(toks, "should")));
            if (!marker) return null;
            CTX.kit = found[1]; CTX.kind = "inc"; CTX.topic = "compare"; CTX.ordList = found.slice();
            return compareKits(found[0], found[1]);
          }
          // ---- Conversation memory: follow-ups resolve against the
          // kit under discussion; a named kit or a topic change moves
          // the context, and it never outlives its usefulness. ----
          function kindInText(toks, skipKit) {
            var price = ["much", "cost", "costs", "price", "prices", "pricing", "expensive", "cheaper", "cheapest"];
            var build = ["build", "builds", "building", "print", "prints", "printed", "printing", "assemble", "assembled", "assembly"];
            var inc = ["included", "include", "includes", "inside", "contents", "come", "comes", "get", "gets", "box", "in"];
            var i, t;
            for (i = 0; i < toks.length; i++) { t = toks[i]; if (t === skipKit) continue; if (price.indexOf(t) !== -1) return "price"; }
            for (i = 0; i < toks.length; i++) { t = toks[i]; if (t === skipKit) continue; if (build.indexOf(t) !== -1) return "build"; }
            for (i = 0; i < toks.length; i++) { t = toks[i]; if (t === skipKit) continue; if (inc.indexOf(t) !== -1) return "inc"; }
            return null;
          }
          function followUp(toks) {
            var named = kitInText(toks);
            var startsAnd = toks[0] === "and";
            if (hasTok(toks, "other") && (hasTok(toks, "one") || hasTok(toks, "ones"))) {
              if (!CTX.kit || CTX.kit === "plushie") return null;
              var nk = KIT_ORDER[(KIT_ORDER.indexOf(CTX.kit) + 1) % KIT_ORDER.length];
              var kd = kindInText(toks, null) || CTX.kind || "price";
              CTX.kit = nk; CTX.kind = kd; CTX.topic = "kit:" + nk;
              return kitAnswer(nk, kd);
            }
            if (named) {
              if (toks[0] === "who") return null;
              var kdN = kindInText(toks, named);
              if (startsAnd || hasTok(toks, "one") || hasTok(toks, "ones") || (toks.length <= 4 && (hasTok(toks, "kit") || hasTok(toks, "kits") || kdN)) || (kdN && toks.length <= 8 && !stmtBlocked(toks) && (kdN !== "inc" || hasTok(toks, "included") || hasTok(toks, "includes") || hasTok(toks, "inside") || hasTok(toks, "contents")))) {
                var kd2 = kdN || CTX.kind || "overview";
                CTX.kit = named;
                if (kd2 !== "overview") CTX.kind = kd2;
                CTX.topic = "kit:" + named;
                return kitAnswer(named, kd2);
              }
              return null;
            }
            if (!CTX.kit) return null;
            var pronoun = hasTok(toks, "it") || hasTok(toks, "that") || hasTok(toks, "this") || hasTok(toks, "its") || hasTok(toks, "there") || hasTok(toks, "they");
            if ((pronoun || startsAnd) && toks.length <= 9) {
              var kd3 = kindInText(toks, null);
              if (!kd3 && !startsAnd) return null;
              kd3 = kd3 || CTX.kind || "overview";
              if (kd3 !== "overview") CTX.kind = kd3;
              return kitAnswer(CTX.kit, kd3);
            }
            return null;
          }
          // ---- TIER-2 / 40% LAYER — statements, corrections,
          // recommendations, derived math, context stack, clarify-
          // don't-guess, full briefs, guided troubleshooting. Every
          // handler below composes only from the verified facts in
          // KITS and the KB, and all of them run after the hard
          // fences above — the safety order never changes. ----
          function stmtBlocked(toks) {
            var W = ["tools", "tool", "battery", "manual", "stage", "stages", "lesson", "lessons", "video", "videos", "discord", "github", "printer", "filament", "simulator", "voice", "download", "box", "size", "dimensions", "trays", "tray", "print", "prints", "printed", "printing"];
            for (var i = 0; i < toks.length; i++) if (W.indexOf(toks[i]) !== -1) return true;
            return false;
          }
          function kitsFound(toks) {
            var out = [];
            for (var i = 0; i < toks.length; i++) {
              var kk = toks[i] === "maker" ? "maker" : toks[i] === "complete" ? "complete" : toks[i] === "built" ? "built" : (toks[i] === "plushie" || toks[i] === "plushies" || toks[i] === "plush") ? "plushie" : null;
              if (kk) out.push({ kit: kk, idx: i });
            }
            return out;
          }
          function numVal(t) {
            if (/^\d{1,4}$/.test(t)) return parseInt(t, 10);
            if (NUMW[t]) return NUMW[t];
            if (t === "couple" || t === "pair") return 2;
            return null;
          }
          function fullBrief(k) {
            var K = KITS[k];
            if (k === "plushie") return K.inc;
            var toolsLine = k === "built"
              ? "none needed — I arrive assembled."
              : "the tool set — HOTO electric screwdriver, Pinecil V2 soldering iron, solder, iFixit Mako 64-bit kit — $123.92, separate / optional (not included in the kit price) — plus a Windows PC for the Stage 2 servo-ID step.";
            CTX.kit = k; CTX.topic = "kit:" + k;
            return "<strong>" + K.name + " — the full rundown.</strong><br>" +
              "<strong>Price:</strong> " + K.priceDisp + " — " + K.blurb + "<br>" +
              "<strong>What&rsquo;s inside:</strong> " + K.inc + "<br>" +
              "<strong>Who builds it:</strong> " + K.build + ".<br>" +
              "<strong>Tools:</strong> " + toolsLine;
          }
          function clarifyChips(kind, question) {
            CTX.pending = { kind: kind };
            if (kind !== "brief") CTX.kind = kind;
            var btns = "";
            ["maker", "complete", "built"].forEach(function (kk) {
              btns += "<button type=\"button\" class=\"ask-chip\" data-q=\"" + KITS[kk].name + "\">" + KITS[kk].name + "</button>";
            });
            return question + "<span class=\"ask-suggest\">" + btns + "</span>";
          }
          // A pending clarifying question resolves the moment the
          // visitor names (or taps) a kit: the original question is
          // answered against that kit, in full.
          function pendingAnswer(toks) {
            if (!CTX.pending) return null;
            var named = kitInText(toks);
            if (!named || named === "plushie" || toks.length > 4) return null;
            if (hasTok(toks, "not")) return null;
            var kind = CTX.pending.kind;
            CTX.pending = null;
            CTX.kit = named;
            if (kind === "brief") return fullBrief(named);
            CTX.kind = kind;
            CTX.topic = "kit:" + named;
            return kitAnswer(named, kind);
          }
          // ---- Corrections & negation: re-route against the stack ----
          function corrections(toks) {
            var named = kitInText(toks);
            var kind = CTX.kind || "overview";
            function ans(k) { CTX.kit = k; CTX.topic = "kit:" + k; return kitAnswer(k, kind); }
            if (named && hasTok(toks, "meant")) return ans(named);
            if (named && hasTok(toks, "back")) return ans(named);
            if (named && toks[0] === "no" && toks.length <= 4) return ans(named);
            if (hasTok(toks, "not") && toks.length <= 10) {
              var found = kitsFound(toks), neg = null, target = null;
              found.forEach(function (f) {
                var isNeg = toks[f.idx - 1] === "not" || toks[f.idx - 2] === "not";
                if (isNeg) neg = f.kit; else target = f.kit;
              });
              if (neg) {
                if (target) return ans(target);
                if (neg !== "plushie") return ans(KIT_ORDER[(KIT_ORDER.indexOf(neg) + 1) % KIT_ORDER.length]);
              }
              return null;
            }
            if (hasTok(toks, "wrong")) {
              if (named) return ans(named);
              if (CTX.kit && CTX.kit !== "plushie" && toks.length <= 4) return ans(KIT_ORDER[(KIT_ORDER.indexOf(CTX.kit) + 1) % KIT_ORDER.length]);
            }
            return null;
          }
          // ---- Mixed carts: "2 maker and 1 built" ----
          function cartMath(toks) {
            var found = kitsFound(toks);
            if (found.length < 2) return null;
            var distinct = {};
            found.forEach(function (f) { distinct[f.kit] = 1; });
            if (Object.keys(distinct).length < 2) return null;
            var pairs = [], anyQty = false;
            for (var m = 0; m < found.length; m++) {
              var f = found[m], qty = null;
              if (f.idx - 1 >= 0) {
                var b1 = numVal(toks[f.idx - 1]);
                if (b1 !== null) qty = b1;
                else if (toks[f.idx - 1] === "a" || toks[f.idx - 1] === "an") qty = 1;
              }
              if (qty === null && f.idx - 2 >= 0 && (toks[f.idx - 1] === "kit" || toks[f.idx - 1] === "kits")) { var b2 = numVal(toks[f.idx - 2]); if (b2 !== null) qty = b2; }
              if (qty === null && f.idx + 1 < toks.length) { var a1 = numVal(toks[f.idx + 1]); if (a1 !== null) qty = a1; }
              if (qty !== null) anyQty = true;
              pairs.push({ kit: f.kit, qty: qty === null ? 1 : qty });
            }
            if (!anyQty) return null;
            var total = 0, lines = [];
            pairs.forEach(function (p) { var K = KITS[p.kit]; total += p.qty * K.price; lines.push(p.qty + " × " + K.name + " (" + K.priceDisp + ") = " + fmt(p.qty * K.price)); });
            CTX.kit = pairs[pairs.length - 1].kit; CTX.kind = "price"; CTX.qty = pairs[0].qty; CTX.topic = "cart";
            return "<strong>Your mix:</strong> " + lines.join(" · ") + ". <strong>Total: " + fmt(total) + ".</strong> Set those quantities on the cards and tap ADD TO CART — the cart keeps the same math, and CHECKOUT sends it to the team. No payment is taken here.";
          }
          // ---- Per-student splits: simple division, labeled ----
          function perStudent(toks) {
            var si = -1;
            for (var i = 0; i < toks.length; i++) if (toks[i] === "student" || toks[i] === "students") { si = i; break; }
            if (si < 0) return null;
            var nS = null;
            for (var d = 1; d <= 3 && nS === null; d++) {
              if (si - d >= 0 && numVal(toks[si - d]) !== null) nS = numVal(toks[si - d]);
              else if (si + d < toks.length && numVal(toks[si + d]) !== null) nS = numVal(toks[si + d]);
            }
            if (!nS || nS < 2) return null;
            var kit = kitInText(toks) || CTX.kit;
            if (!kit || kit === "plushie") return null;
            var qty = 1;
            var found = kitsFound(toks);
            if (found.length && found[0].idx - 1 >= 0 && numVal(toks[found[0].idx - 1]) !== null && found[0].idx - 1 !== si - 1) qty = numVal(toks[found[0].idx - 1]);
            var K = KITS[kit], total = qty * K.price, per = total / nS;
            CTX.kit = kit; CTX.kind = "price"; CTX.qty = qty; CTX.topic = "kit:" + kit;
            return "<strong>" + qty + " × " + K.name + "</strong> = " + fmt(total) + " ÷ " + nS + " students = <strong>" + fmt(per) + " per student</strong>. That&rsquo;s simple division of the kit total — not a per-student price Vulcan publishes; a school buys the kit, and the students share the robot.";
          }
          // ---- Numeric differences between two kits ----
          function diffMath(toks) {
            if (!(hasTok(toks, "more") || hasTok(toks, "less") || hasTok(toks, "difference") || hasTok(toks, "cheaper") || hasTok(toks, "expensive") || hasTok(toks, "pricier") || hasTok(toks, "apart"))) return null;
            var found = kitsFound(toks), seen = {}, list = [];
            found.forEach(function (f) { if (!seen[f.kit] && f.kit !== "plushie") { seen[f.kit] = 1; list.push(f.kit); } });
            if (list.length < 2) return null;
            var A = KITS[list[0]], B = KITS[list[1]];
            var hi = A.price >= B.price ? A : B, lo = hi === A ? B : A;
            CTX.kind = "price"; CTX.topic = "compare"; CTX.ordList = list.slice();
            return "Price difference: the <strong>" + hi.name + "</strong> runs <strong>" + fmt(hi.price - lo.price) + "</strong> more than the <strong>" + lo.name + "</strong> — " + hi.priceDisp + " vs " + lo.priceDisp + ". Same robot, same 163-page manual, same 14 lessons; the gap is who prints the body — and whether anyone builds at all.";
          }
          // ---- Recommendations from verified kit traits ----
          function parseAmount(toks) {
            var best = null;
            for (var i = 0; i < toks.length; i++) {
              var t = toks[i], v = null;
              if (/^\d+k$/.test(t)) v = parseInt(t, 10) * 1000;
              else if (/^\d{3,6}$/.test(t)) v = parseInt(t, 10);
              else if (/^\d{1,2}$/.test(t) && i + 1 < toks.length && /^\d{3}$/.test(toks[i + 1])) v = parseInt(t, 10) * 1000 + parseInt(toks[i + 1], 10);
              if (v !== null && v >= 100 && (best === null || v > best)) best = v;
            }
            return best;
          }

          // ---- Quantity carry-over: "and for 3 schools?" ----
          function carryQty(toks) {
            if (!CTX.kit || CTX.kit === "plushie") return null;
            if (kitInText(toks)) return null;
            if (hasTok(toks, "lesson") || hasTok(toks, "lessons") || hasTok(toks, "stage") || hasTok(toks, "page") || hasTok(toks, "students") || hasTok(toks, "student")) return null;

          // ---- Ordinals against the list under discussion ----
          function ordinalRoute(toks) {
            if (hasTok(toks, "lesson") || hasTok(toks, "lessons") || hasTok(toks, "stage") || hasTok(toks, "phase")) return null;
            var ORD = { first: 0, second: 1, third: 2 };
            var idx = -1;
            for (var i = 0; i < toks.length; i++) if (ORD[toks[i]] !== undefined) { idx = ORD[toks[i]]; break; }
            if (idx < 0) return null;
            if (!(hasTok(toks, "one") || hasTok(toks, "kit") || hasTok(toks, "option") || toks.length <= 4)) return null;
            var list = (CTX.ordList && CTX.ordList.length > idx) ? CTX.ordList : KIT_ORDER;
            var k = list[idx];
            var kind = kindInText(toks, null) || CTX.kind || "overview";
            CTX.kit = k;
            if (kind !== "overview") CTX.kind = kind;
            CTX.topic = "kit:" + k;
            return kitAnswer(k, kind);
          }
          // ---- Full-brief mode ----
          function briefRoute(toks) {

            var k = named || CTX.kit;

            return clarifyChips("brief", "The full rundown on which kit — <strong>Maker</strong>, <strong>Complete</strong>, or <strong>Built</strong>? Tap one and I&rsquo;ll lay it all out.");
          }
          // ---- Statement & fragment forms ----
          function statementRoute(toks) {
            if (!toks.length) return null;
            var named = kitInText(toks);
            var tallSet = { the: 1, tall: 1, one: 1, big: 1, robot: 1, it: 1, that: 1 };

            for (var i = 0; i < toks.length; i++) if (!tallSet[toks[i]]) { allTall = false; break; }
            if (allTall && hasTok(toks, "tall")) return KB_BY_ID.height;
            if (allTall && hasTok(toks, "big")) return KB_BY_ID.sizeBody;

            if (CTX.kit && toks.length <= 3 && !hasTok(toks, "and")) {
              var FRAG_OK = { how: 1, much: 1, is: 1, it: 1, that: 1, the: 1, price: 1, cost: 1, costs: 1, what: 1, whats: 1, s: 1, included: 1, inside: 1, contents: 1, box: 1, in: 1, come: 1, comes: 1, get: 1, gets: 1, about: 1 };

              }
              if (allFrag && strong) { var kd = kindInText(toks, null); if (kd) { CTX.kind = kd; return kitAnswer(CTX.kit, kd); } }
            }
            var MORE_OK = { tell: 1, me: 1, more: 1, about: 1, it: 1, that: 1, this: 1, please: 1, details: 1, detail: 1, info: 1, information: 1, extra: 1, go: 1, on: 1 };
            var allMore = toks.length > 0;
            for (var m = 0; m < toks.length; m++) if (!MORE_OK[toks[m]]) { allMore = false; break; }
            if (allMore && toks.length <= 6 && (hasTok(toks, "more") || hasTok(toks, "details") || hasTok(toks, "detail") || hasTok(toks, "info"))) {

          // ---- Clarify, don't guess: bare ambiguous asks ----

            return null;

              no: "Then start there — the sequence is the developer setup (<a href=\"https://vulcanrobotics.ai/docs/lerobot\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener\">vulcanrobotics.ai/docs/lerobot</a>): install the robot profile, run <code>sourccey-setup robot</code>, verify the device aliases, then <code>uv run sourccey-host</code> — ready when it prints &ldquo;Waiting for commands…&rdquo;. Driving before the host is up isn&rsquo;t a fault; it&rsquo;s just early. Host up and still nothing → tell me which input you&rsquo;re driving with."
            },
            tsBroken: {
              yes: "Good — power&rsquo;s alive, so it&rsquo;s not the Stage 5 main-power fault. Next fork: <strong>what&rsquo;s misbehaving — an arm or joint, a wheel, a camera, or driving / recording?</strong> Name the one and I&rsquo;ll walk its manual check, step by step.",
              no: "Then we start where the manual starts — power, in order: <strong>(1)</strong> Read the battery gauge out loud (Lesson 9&rsquo;s rule).             }
          };
          function troubleFollow(toks) {
            if (!CTX.trouble) return null;
            var B = TROUBLE_BRANCH[CTX.trouble];
            if (!B || toks.length > 8) return null;
            var YES_T = ["yes", "yeah", "yep", "yup", "lit", "lights", "light", "spins", "spin", "moves", "works", "does", "shows", "showing"];
            var NO_T = ["no", "nope", "nah", "nothing", "dark", "dead", "never", "doesnt", "doesn", "missing"];
            var isYes = false, isNo = false, i;
            for (i = 0; i < toks.length; i++) { if (YES_T.indexOf(toks[i]) !== -1) isYes = true; if (NO_T.indexOf(toks[i]) !== -1) isNo = true; }
            if (isYes && !isNo) return B.yes;
            if (isNo) return B.no;
            return null;
          }
          // ---- Compound questions: two real questions, two answers ----
          function compoundAnswer() {
            if (q.indexOf(" and ") === -1) return null;
            if (bestMatch(qTokens, false).score >= 5) return null;
            var rawParts = q.trim().split(" and ");
            var parts = [];
            for (var i = 0; i < rawParts.length; i++) {
              var pt = rawParts[i].trim().split(" ").filter(function (t) { return t.length > 0; });
              if (pt.length >= 3) parts.push(pt);
              else if (pt.length >= 1 && bestMatch(pt, false).score >= 1) parts.push(pt);
            }
            if (parts.length < 2) return null;
            var answers = [], seen = {};
            for (var p = 0; p < parts.length && answers.length < 3; p++) {
              var m = bestMatch(parts[p], false);
              if (!m.entry || m.score <= 0) { m = bestMatch(parts[p], true); if (!m.entry || m.score < 1.5) continue; }
              if (seen[m.entry.id]) continue;
              seen[m.entry.id] = 1;
              answers.push(m);
            }
            if (answers.length < 2) return null;
            var out = [];
            for (var a = 0; a < answers.length; a++) { noteCtx(answers[a].entry, qTokens); out.push(answers[a].entry.a); }
            return out.join("<br><br>");
          }
          // ---- FULL-KNOWLEDGE WIRING — the manual itself, absorbed.
          // The 172-entry verified transcription of the Assembly
          // Manual (window.MANUAL_KB, data:application/javascript;base64, — the same
          // transcription the manual sheet's own agent reads) is
          // searchable from this chat: a build question the distilled

          // page, cited "Manual page N of 163". This layer runs only
          // after the hard fences, every tier-2 handler, the exact
          // scored match, the fuzzy match, and the social layer have
          // had their chance,
          // so nothing already answered can be stolen — it exists for

          var MAN_DF = {};
          var MAN_STOP2 = {};
          ["the", "a", "an", "of", "to", "in", "on", "for", "is", "are", "do", "does", "did", "how", "where", "what", "which", "when", "why", "i", "my", "me", "it", "its", "that", "this", "with", "and", "or", "can", "could", "should", "would", "need", "get", "go", "find", "show", "shows", "tell", "page", "pages", "manual", "please", "into", "from", "about", "there", "one", "two", "all", "any", "was", "were", "be", "been", "has", "have", "had", "you", "your", "we", "they", "them", "then", "than", "if", "but", "just", "like", "use", "using", "used", "make", "makes", "say", "says", "much", "many", "figure", "figures", "stage", "know", "want"].forEach(function (w) { MAN_STOP2[manNorm2(w)] = 1; });
          function manNorm2(w) {
            w = String(w).toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, "");
            if (w.length > 4 && /ing$/.test(w)) w = w.slice(0, -3);
            if (w.length > 4 && /ed$/.test(w)) w = w.slice(0, -2);
            if (w.length > 3 && /s$/.test(w) && !/ss$/.test(w)) w = w.slice(0, -1);
            return w;
          }
          function manSet2(text) {
            var set = {};
            String(text).toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9 ]/g, " ").split(/\s+/).forEach(function (w) {
              var n = manNorm2(w);
              if (n) set[n] = 1;
            });
            return set;
          }
          function manPrep2(MAN) {
            if (MAN._prepped2) return;
            MAN._prepped2 = true;
            MAN.forEach(function (e) {
              e._ct = manSet2(e.t);
              e._cx = manSet2(e.x);
              if (e.p === 1 || e.s.indexOf("Clinic") !== -1) return;
              for (var w in e._ct) MAN_DF[w] = (MAN_DF[w] || 0) + 1;
            });
          }
          function manEsc(s) {
            return String(s).replace(/&/g, "&amp;").replace(/</g, "&lt;").replace(/>/g, "&gt;");
          }
          function manExcerpt2(x, n) {
            if (x.length <= n) return x;
            var cut = x.slice(0, n), dot = cut.lastIndexOf(". ");
            if (dot > n * 0.5) return cut.slice(0, dot + 1);
            return cut + "…";
          }
          function manRich(e) {
            var t = e.t.toLowerCase();
            var r = Math.min(e.x.length, 400) / 1000;
            if (/materials|procedure|steps|testing/.test(t)) r += 2;
            if (t.indexOf("figure") !== 0) r += 1;
            return r;
          }
          function manAnswer(e, lead) {
            var stage = e.s.split(" — ")[0];
            return lead + "<strong>" + manEsc(e.t) + "</strong> (" + manEsc(stage) + "): " + manEsc(manExcerpt2(e.x, 340)) + " <em>— Manual page " + e.p + " of 163</em>";
          }
          function manFind(toks) {
            var MAN = window.MANUAL_KB || [];
            if (!MAN.length || !toks.length) return null;
            manPrep2(MAN);
            var i, pageN = null, stageN = null;
            for (i = 0; i < toks.length; i++) {
              if ((toks[i] === "page" || toks[i] === "p") && /^\d{1,3}$/.test(toks[i + 1] || "")) pageN = parseInt(toks[i + 1], 10);
              if ((toks[i] === "last" || toks[i] === "final") && toks[i + 1] === "page") pageN = 163;
              if (toks[i] === "stage" && /^\d{1,2}$/.test(toks[i + 1] || "")) stageN = parseInt(toks[i + 1], 10);
            }
            // The contents page answers contents questions directly.
            var contentsAsk = (hasTok(toks, "table") && (hasTok(toks, "contents") || hasTok(toks, "content"))) || (hasTok(toks, "contents") && hasTok(toks, "manual"));
            if (contentsAsk) {
              for (i = 0; i < MAN.length; i++) if (MAN[i].p === 2 && MAN[i].t.indexOf("Contents") === 0) return { e: MAN[i], sc: 99, kind: "page", stage: stageN, mat: false, proc: true };
            }
            if (pageN !== null) {
              if (pageN < 2 || pageN > 163) return null;
              var cands = [];
              MAN.forEach(function (e) { if (e.p === pageN && e.s.indexOf("Clinic") === -1) cands.push(e); });
              if (!cands.length) return null;
              cands.sort(function (a, b) { return manRich(b) - manRich(a); });
              return { e: cands[0], sc: 99, kind: "page", stage: stageN, mat: false, proc: true };
            }
            var qset = {}, qlist = [];
            toks.forEach(function (t) {
              if (/^\d+$/.test(t)) return;
              var n = manNorm2(t);
              if (n === "thermistor") n = "thermister"; // the book's own spelling (p.86)
              if (!n || n.length < 2 || MAN_STOP2[n] || qset[n]) return;
              qset[n] = 1; qlist.push(n);
            });
            if (!qlist.length) return null;
            // The subject's generic words can support a hit but can
            // never BE the hit — "are you a robot" is conversation,
            // not a manual question.
            var MAN_GENERIC = { robot: 1, sourccey: 1, vulcan: 1 };
            var sole = qlist.length === 1 ? qlist[0] : null;
            if (sole && stageN === null && (MAN_GENERIC[sole] || (MAN_DF[sole] || 99) > 4)) return null;
            var best = null, bestSc = 0, bestRich = -1;
            MAN.forEach(function (e) {
              if (e.p === 1 || e.s.indexOf("Clinic") !== -1) return;
              var th = 0, xh = 0, distinct = false;
              qlist.forEach(function (w) {
                if (MAN_GENERIC[w]) return;
                if (e._ct[w]) { th++; if ((MAN_DF[w] || 99) <= 15) distinct = true; }
                else if (e._cx[w]) xh++;
              });
              if (!th) return;
              var sc = th * 4 + xh + (distinct ? 2 : 0);
              if (stageN !== null && e.s.indexOf("Stage " + stageN + " ") === 0) sc += 3;
              var rich = manRich(e);
              if (sc > bestSc || (sc === bestSc && rich > bestRich)) { best = e; bestSc = sc; bestRich = rich; }
            });
            if (!best || bestSc < 6) return null;
            var proc = hasTok(toks, "how") || hasTok(toks, "where") || hasTok(toks, "which") || hasTok(toks, "what") || hasTok(toks, "when");
            return { e: best, sc: bestSc, kind: "search", stage: stageN, mat: !!qset.material, book: !!qset.label, proc: proc };
          }
          // The pre-match gate: the book may answer ahead of the
          // distilled entries only on a strong book signal — an
          // explicit page/contents reference, a materials ask, a
          // procedural question with a heavy title match, or a
          // stage-qualified question. Everything else reaches the
          // book only after the scored matching, as the long tail.
          function manGate(f) {
            if (!f) return false;
            if (f.kind === "page") return true;
            if (f.mat && f.sc >= 8) return true;
            if (f.book && f.sc >= 9) return true;
            if (f.proc && f.sc >= 11) return true;
            if (f.stage !== null && f.sc >= 10) return true;
            return false;
          }
          function manRender(f) {
            return manAnswer(f.e, f.kind === "page" ? "Page " + f.e.p + " of the book — " : "Straight from the book — ");
          }
          var pendAns = pendingAnswer(qTokens); if (pendAns) return pendAns;
          CTX.pending = null;
          var tbAns = troubleFollow(qTokens); if (tbAns) { CTX.trouble = null; return tbAns; }
          CTX.trouble = null;
          var cartAns = cartMath(qTokens); if (cartAns) return cartAns;
          var stuAns = perStudent(qTokens); if (stuAns) return stuAns;
          var mathAns = kitMath(qTokens); if (mathAns) return mathAns;
          var diffAns = diffMath(qTokens); if (diffAns) return diffAns;
          var cmpAns = kitCompare(qTokens); if (cmpAns) return cmpAns;
          var corAns = corrections(qTokens); if (corAns) return corAns;
          var recAns = recommend(qTokens); if (recAns) return recAns;
          var cqAns = carryQty(qTokens); if (cqAns) return cqAns;
          var fuAns = followUp(qTokens); if (fuAns) return fuAns;
          var ordAns = ordinalRoute(qTokens); if (ordAns) return ordAns;
          var briefAns = briefRoute(qTokens); if (briefAns) return briefAns;
          var stAns = statementRoute(qTokens); if (stAns) return stAns;
          var compAns = compoundAnswer(); if (compAns) return compAns;
          var clarAns = clarifyBare(qTokens); if (clarAns) return clarAns;
          // ---- The manual, strong-signal pass: page references,
          // contents, materials asks, and heavy procedural matches
          // are the book's to answer, ahead of the distilled entries
          // (whose pointer/price answers don't carry the detail). ----
          var manPre = manFind(qTokens);
          if (manPre && manGate(manPre)) return manRender(manPre);
          // ---- Scored matching over the knowledge base (exact) ----
          var wholeM = bestMatch(qTokens, false);
          var fz = bestMatch(qTokens, true);
          // A bare generic opener ("tell me about…") floors at 0.5; if a
          // real topic scores higher fuzzily, the opener must not win.
          if (wholeM.entry && !(wholeM.score <= 0.5 && fz.score > wholeM.score)) { noteCtx(wholeM.entry, qTokens); return wholeM.entry.a; }
          // ---- Fuzzy matching: close enough earns the real answer ----
          if (fz.entry && fz.score >= 1.5) { noteCtx(fz.entry, qTokens); return fz.entry.a; }
          // ---- Social layer ----
          // Conversation first: greetings, small talk, thanks and
          // goodbyes get a person's answer, in character. This runs
          // only after every factual topic above (hard rules + the
          // scored knowledge base) has had its chance — but ahead of
          // the manual's long-tail retrieval, so a conversational
          // phrase can never be answered with a book excerpt — and
          // its shapes
          // are whole-message social ones, so it can never steal a
          // factual question — anything unrecognized still lands on
          // the fallback, word for word.
          // ---- Social layer (rebuilt for real phone typing) ----
          // The old net matched whole phrases byte-for-byte, so the
          // way people actually type on a phone — "Watsup man",
          // "heyy", "hows it going", "thx", "bet" — fell straight
          // through to the fallback. This net is token-based: it
          // canonicalizes sloppy tokens (letter runs collapse, so
          // heyy/hiii/coool land; what's/how's re-merge their
          // apostrophe-s; wassup/wazzup fold into watsup), strips a
          // leading greeting plus vocatives (man, dude, there, the
          // name itself) off the front and back, then runs the SAME
          // fuzzy token equality used on knowledge cues (exact, or
          // one edit for words of 4+ letters) over the social
          // intents. Safety order is unchanged: hard fences and the
          // scored knowledge base have already had their chance, so a
          // greeting glued to a real question ("hey how much is the
          // maker kit") is answered by the knowledge base above and
          // never reaches here; and every intent below is a
          // whole-remainder shape, so a greeting can never swallow a
          // question this layer doesn't recognize — that still lands
          // on the did-you-mean menu or the byte-exact fallback.
          // Social answers are conversation, not brochures: one
          // short line each, in persona, no topic lists. A pure
          // greeting gets a mirrored greeting back — the full
          // capabilities menu lives ONLY in HELP_ANSWER, reached by
          // who-are-you / what-can-you-do / help questions, never by
          // a hello.
          var GREET_VARIANTS = ["Watsup! 🤖", "Hey hey! 🤖", "Yo! 🤖 Good to see you."];
          function greetReply() {
            if (sToks.indexOf("morning") !== -1 || sToks.indexOf("mornin") !== -1) return "Good morning! 🤖";
            if (sToks.indexOf("afternoon") !== -1) return "Good afternoon! 🤖";
            if (sToks.indexOf("evening") !== -1) return "Good evening! 🤖";
            var v = GREET_VARIANTS[GREET_N % GREET_VARIANTS.length];
            GREET_N++;
            return v;
          }
          var HELP_ANSWER = "That&rsquo;s me — <strong>Sourccey</strong>, the open-source robot you teach. Ask me about <strong>kit prices</strong>, <strong>what&rsquo;s included</strong>, the <strong>14 lessons</strong>, <strong>assembly help and troubleshooting</strong> (I know the whole 163-page manual, stage by stage — tell me the symptom and I&rsquo;ll walk the fix), <strong>software</strong>, <strong>specs &amp; parts</strong>, or <strong>videos &amp; links</strong>.";
          var HOWRU_ANSWER = "All systems green — servos reporting, LiDAR spinning. 🤖 How are you?";
          var WHORU_ANSWER = "I&rsquo;m <strong>Sourccey</strong> — Vulcan Robotics&rsquo; open-source robot you teach. One metre tall, 24 smart servos, zero secrets. 🤖";
          var ROBOT_ANSWER = "Ha — yes, robot, proudly. 🤖 Open-source hardware, a Pi 5 brain, 24 smart servos — the real deal.";
          var THANKS_ANSWER = "Anytime! 🤖 That&rsquo;s what I&rsquo;m here for.";
          var BYE_ANSWER = "See you! 🤖 I&rsquo;ll be right here — probably mid-fold.";
          var LAUGH_ANSWER = "Ha! 🤖 Five-star diagnostic, logged.";
          var REACT_ANSWER = "Right?? 🤖 One metre of open-source robot — I&rsquo;m a little proud myself.";
          var ACK_ANSWER = "Bet. 🤖 Locked in.";
          var YES_ANSWER = "Love it. 🤖 What&rsquo;s next?";
          var NO_ANSWER = "All good — no pressure from the robot. 🤖";
          var SMALLTALK_ANSWER = "Ha — same here: mid-fold, living the dream. 🤖";
          function socCanon(t) {
            var c = t.replace(/(.)\1+/g, "$1");
            if (c === "wasup" || c === "wazup") c = "watsup";
            return c;
          }
          function socSet(list) { return list.map(function (w) { return socCanon(w); }); }
          // Social tokens: the normalized question tokens with
          // what's/how's re-merged and every token canonicalized.
          var sToks = [];
          for (var si = 0; si < qTokens.length; si++) {
            var st0 = qTokens[si];
            if ((st0 === "what" || st0 === "how") && qTokens[si + 1] === "s") { sToks.push(st0 + "s"); si++; continue; }
            if (st0 === "s") continue;
            sToks.push(socCanon(st0));
          }
          function socCue(phrase) {
            var raw = phrase.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, " ").split(" ").filter(function (x) { return x.length > 0; });
            var out = [];
            for (var i = 0; i < raw.length; i++) {
              if ((raw[i] === "what" || raw[i] === "how") && raw[i + 1] === "s") { out.push(raw[i] + "s"); i++; continue; }
              if (raw[i] === "s") continue;
              out.push(socCanon(raw[i]));
            }
            return out;
          }
          function socTokEq(a, b) {
            if (a === b) return true;
            // One-edit typo tolerance, anchored on the first letter —
            // without the anchor, distinct slang words one edit apart
            // ("nope" / "dope") would collide across intents.
            if (a.length >= 4 && b.length >= 4 && a.charAt(0) === b.charAt(0) && lev(a, b) <= 1) return true;
            return false;
          }
          function socIn(t, set) {
            for (var i = 0; i < set.length; i++) if (socTokEq(t, set[i])) return true;
            return false;
          }
          function socPhraseHit(phrase, toks) {
            var ct = socCue(phrase);
            if (!ct.length || ct.length > toks.length) return false;
            for (var s0 = 0; s0 + ct.length <= toks.length; s0++) {
              var ok = true;
              for (var w = 0; w < ct.length; w++) if (!socTokEq(toks[s0 + w], ct[w])) { ok = false; break; }
              if (ok) return true;
            }
            return false;
          }
          function socPhraseAtStart(phrase, toks) {
            var ct = socCue(phrase);
            if (!ct.length || ct.length > toks.length) return false;
            for (var w = 0; w < ct.length; w++) if (!socTokEq(toks[w], ct[w])) return false;
            return true;
          }
          // Whole-remainder shape: every token belongs to the
          // intent's vocabulary and at least one is a core word.
          function socWholeIn(toks, vocab, core) {
            if (!toks.length) return false;
            var hasCore = false;
            for (var i = 0; i < toks.length; i++) {
              if (!socIn(toks[i], vocab)) return false;
              if (socIn(toks[i], core)) hasCore = true;
            }
            return hasCore;
          }
          var GREET_TOKS = socSet(["hi", "hello", "hey", "yo", "sup", "watsup", "wassup", "whatsup", "hiya", "howdy", "gm", "greetings", "morning", "gud", "mornin"]);
          var GREET_PHRASES = ["whats up", "what up", "what is up", "whats good", "good morning", "good afternoon", "good evening", "hey there", "hi there", "hello there"];
          var FILLER_TOKS = socSet(["there", "man", "dude", "bro", "guys", "everyone", "everybody", "yall", "friend", "friends", "buddy", "fam", "all"]);
          var NAME_TOK = socCanon("sourccey");
          // Strip a leading greeting (token or phrase), the name, and
          // vocative fillers off the front; fillers and the name off
          // the back too. What remains is what the visitor actually
          // said beyond the hello.
          var rest = sToks.slice();
          var greeted = false;
          var stripping = true;
          while (stripping && rest.length) {
            stripping = false;
            for (var gp = 0; gp < GREET_PHRASES.length; gp++) {
              if (socPhraseAtStart(GREET_PHRASES[gp], rest)) { rest = rest.slice(socCue(GREET_PHRASES[gp]).length); greeted = true; stripping = true; break; }
            }
            if (stripping) continue;
            if (socIn(rest[0], GREET_TOKS)) { rest = rest.slice(1); greeted = true; stripping = true; continue; }
            if (rest[0] === NAME_TOK) { rest = rest.slice(1); greeted = true; stripping = true; continue; }
            if (socIn(rest[0], FILLER_TOKS)) { rest = rest.slice(1); stripping = true; continue; }
          }
          while (rest.length) {
            var lastTok = rest[rest.length - 1];
            if (lastTok === NAME_TOK || socIn(lastTok, FILLER_TOKS)) { rest = rest.slice(0, rest.length - 1); continue; }
            break;
          }
          // "gud morning" / "mornin" — the time word alone is the greeting.
          if (rest.length === 1 && (rest[0] === "morning" || rest[0] === "mornin")) rest = [];
          if (rest.length && rest.length <= 7) {
            var HOWRU_PHRASES = ["how are you", "how are u", "how r u", "hows it going", "how is it going", "how are things", "how are things going", "hows things", "hows everything", "how is everything", "how do you feel", "how you doing", "how are you doing", "hows you", "how you been", "how have you been", "how is life", "how goes it"];
            for (var hp = 0; hp < HOWRU_PHRASES.length; hp++) if (socPhraseHit(HOWRU_PHRASES[hp], rest)) return HOWRU_ANSWER;
            var WHORU_PHRASES = ["who are you", "who is sourccey", "who r you", "who are u", "what are you", "your name", "what is your name", "introduce yourself", "who is this", "who dis", "who is dis"];
            if (rest.length <= 6) for (var wp = 0; wp < WHORU_PHRASES.length; wp++) if (socPhraseHit(WHORU_PHRASES[wp], rest)) return WHORU_ANSWER;
            var HELP_PHRASES = ["what can you do", "what do you do", "what can i ask", "what can i ask you", "what do you know", "what can you help with", "show me the menu", "what are the options", "what are my options", "can you help me", "help me"];
            if (rest.length <= 6) for (var ep = 0; ep < HELP_PHRASES.length; ep++) if (socPhraseHit(HELP_PHRASES[ep], rest)) return HELP_ANSWER;
            var SMALL_PHRASES = ["not much", "nothing much", "not a lot", "same old", "just chilling", "chilling", "just hanging out", "hanging out"];
            if (rest.length <= 5) for (var sp = 0; sp < SMALL_PHRASES.length; sp++) if (socPhraseHit(SMALL_PHRASES[sp], rest)) return SMALLTALK_ANSWER;
            // Reunions, first meetings, and check-ins. These are
            // WHOLE-remainder shapes — the phrase must be the entire
            // message — so they can never swallow a factual question
            // that merely contains one ("what's new in the box"
            // keeps its factual path). They run ahead of the goodbye
            // shapes below on purpose: "good to see you" is a hello,
            // not a "see you" goodbye.
            function socWholePhrase(phrase, toks) {
              var ct = socCue(phrase);
              if (!ct.length || ct.length !== toks.length) return false;
              for (var w = 0; w < ct.length; w++) if (!socTokEq(toks[w], ct[w])) return false;
              return true;
            }
            var REUNION_PHRASES = ["long time no see", "been a while", "it been a while", "its been a while", "long time", "good to see you", "nice to see you", "great to see you", "it good to see you", "its good to see you", "missed you", "i missed you", "where have you been", "where you been", "welcome back"];
            for (var up = 0; up < REUNION_PHRASES.length; up++) if (socWholePhrase(REUNION_PHRASES[up], rest)) return "Long time no see! 🤖 Good to see you.";
            var MEET_PHRASES = ["nice to meet you", "good to meet you", "pleased to meet you", "great to meet you", "how do you do"];
            for (var mp = 0; mp < MEET_PHRASES.length; mp++) if (socWholePhrase(MEET_PHRASES[mp], rest)) return "Good to meet you! 🤖";
            var NEWS_PHRASES = ["whats new", "what is new"];
            for (var np = 0; np < NEWS_PHRASES.length; np++) if (socWholePhrase(NEWS_PHRASES[np], rest)) return "Oh, you know — folding, learning, looking sharp. 🤖 What&rsquo;s new with you?";
            var DAY_PHRASES = ["hows your day", "how is your day", "how was your day", "hows your day going", "how is your day going"];
            for (var dp = 0; dp < DAY_PHRASES.length; dp++) if (socWholePhrase(DAY_PHRASES[dp], rest)) return "All systems green and the day&rsquo;s folding nicely. 🤖 How&rsquo;s yours?";
            if (socWholePhrase("whats going on", rest) || socWholePhrase("what is going on", rest) || socWholePhrase("whats happening", rest) || socWholePhrase("what is happening", rest)) return greetReply();
            var COMPLIMENT_PHRASES = ["good job", "great job", "nice job", "good work", "great work", "nice work", "well done"];
            for (var cp = 0; cp < COMPLIMENT_PHRASES.length; cp++) if (socWholePhrase(COMPLIMENT_PHRASES[cp], rest)) return REACT_ANSWER;
            var ROBOT_PHRASES = ["are you a robot", "are you real", "are you human", "are you alive", "are you a bot", "are you an ai", "are you actually a robot", "you a robot", "are u a robot", "r u a robot", "are you ai", "are u human", "are you a real robot"];
            for (var rp = 0; rp < ROBOT_PHRASES.length; rp++) if (socPhraseHit(ROBOT_PHRASES[rp], rest)) return ROBOT_ANSWER;
          }
          var THANKS_VOCAB = socSet(["thank", "thanks", "thx", "thanx", "ty", "tysm", "u", "you", "so", "much", "a", "lot", "really", "very", "appreciate", "it", "that", "tons", "bunch"]);
          var THANKS_CORE = socSet(["thank", "thanks", "thx", "thanx", "ty", "tysm", "appreciate"]);
          if (rest.length <= 6 && socWholeIn(rest, THANKS_VOCAB, THANKS_CORE)) return THANKS_ANSWER;
          if (rest.length <= 8 && (socPhraseHit("thank you", rest) || socPhraseHit("thank u", rest))) return THANKS_ANSWER;
          var BYE_PHRASES = ["goodbye", "see you later", "see you", "see ya", "good night", "gotta go", "bye bye", "take care", "have a good day", "have a great day", "have a nice day"];
          if (rest.length <= 6) for (var bp = 0; bp < BYE_PHRASES.length; bp++) if (socPhraseHit(BYE_PHRASES[bp], rest)) return BYE_ANSWER;
          var BYE_VOCAB = socSet(["bye", "goodbye", "see", "you", "ya", "u", "later", "good", "night", "gotta", "go", "gtg", "cya", "peace", "out", "im", "leaving", "soon", "for", "now"]);
          var BYE_CORE = socSet(["bye", "goodbye", "see", "gotta", "cya", "gtg", "peace", "later"]);
          if (rest.length <= 5 && socWholeIn(rest, BYE_VOCAB, BYE_CORE)) return BYE_ANSWER;
          var LAUGH_TOKS = socSet(["lol", "lmao", "rofl", "haha", "hahaha", "hehe", "lmfao"]);
          if (rest.length <= 4) {
            var hasLaugh = false, laughOk = true;
            for (var li = 0; li < rest.length; li++) {
              if (socIn(rest[li], LAUGH_TOKS) || /^[ha]+$/.test(rest[li])) { hasLaugh = true; continue; }
              if (socIn(rest[li], socSet(["ok", "okay", "cool", "nice", "wow"]))) continue;
              laughOk = false; break;
            }
            if (hasLaugh && laughOk) return LAUGH_ANSWER;
          }
          var REACT_VOCAB = socSet(["cool", "nice", "awesome", "sweet", "wow", "great", "amazing", "neat", "dope", "sick", "fire", "lit", "rad", "love", "it", "that", "this", "so", "very", "really", "ok", "okay", "perfect", "excellent", "solid", "legit", "good", "best"]);
          var REACT_CORE = socSet(["cool", "nice", "awesome", "sweet", "wow", "amazing", "neat", "dope", "sick", "fire", "lit", "perfect", "excellent", "great", "love"]);
          if (rest.length <= 4 && socWholeIn(rest, REACT_VOCAB, REACT_CORE)) return REACT_ANSWER;
          var ACK_VOCAB = socSet(["bet", "got", "it", "understood", "say", "less", "word", "facts", "fair", "enough", "copy", "that", "roger"]);
          var ACK_CORE = socSet(["bet", "understood", "word", "facts", "less", "got", "copy"]);
          if (rest.length <= 3 && socWholeIn(rest, ACK_VOCAB, ACK_CORE)) return ACK_ANSWER;
          var YES_VOCAB = socSet(["yes", "yeah", "yep", "yup", "yea", "sure", "ok", "okay", "k", "kk", "alright", "sounds", "good", "please", "absolutely", "definitely", "ye"]);
          var YES_CORE = socSet(["yes", "yeah", "yep", "yup", "yea", "sure", "ok", "okay", "k", "kk", "alright", "sounds", "absolutely", "definitely"]);
          if (rest.length <= 3 && socWholeIn(rest, YES_VOCAB, YES_CORE)) return YES_ANSWER;
          var NO_VOCAB = socSet(["no", "nope", "nah", "not", "really", "never", "nada"]);
          var NO_CORE = socSet(["no", "nope", "nah"]);
          if (rest.length <= 3 && socWholeIn(rest, NO_VOCAB, NO_CORE)) return NO_ANSWER;
          // A pure greeting — nothing left once the hello and its
          // trailing words come off — gets the greeting answer. A
          // greeting with a remainder this layer doesn't recognize
          // falls through untouched: the question keeps its chance at
          // the did-you-mean menu and the fallback below.
          if (greeted && !rest.length) return greetReply();
          // ---- The manual, long-tail pass — RANKING (enforced):
          // the priority order in this brain is (1) hard fences,
          // (2) social intents, (3) scored knowledge topics,
          // (4) the manual retrieval layer, (5) did-you-mean menus,
          // (6) the byte-exact fallback. The book's strong-signal
          // ground — explicit page/contents references, materials,
          // figures, heavy procedural matches — is claimed by the
          // gated pass ahead of the scored match, and page-reference
          // questions still answer from the book with citations.
          // Everything the book answers down here is the long tail,
          // and it runs BELOW conversation on purpose: a stray
          // phrase like "long time no see" is a greeting, not a
          // camera-cable excerpt. ----
          var manPost = manFind(qTokens);
          if (manPost) return manRender(manPost);
          // ---- No more walls: a near-miss earns a did-you-mean menu.
          // The byte-exact fallback below remains only for genuine
          // unknowns and gibberish — nothing with a close topic in the
          // knowledge base reaches it any more. ----
          if (!qTokens.length) return "🤖 Received loud and clear!";
          var ranked = [];
          for (var r = 0; r < KB.length; r++) {
            var rs = scoreEntry(KB[r], qTokens, true);
            if (rs > 0.4 && LABELS[KB[r].id]) ranked.push({ entry: KB[r], score: rs });
          }
          ranked.sort(function (x, y) { return y.score - x.score; });
          if (ranked.length) {
            var btns = "";
            for (var b = 0; b < ranked.length && b < 3; b++) {
              var L = LABELS[ranked[b].entry.id];
              btns += "<button type=\"button\" class=\"ask-chip\" data-q=\"" + L[1] + "\">" + L[0] + "</button>";
            }
            return "Close — I want to give you the right answer, not a bluff. Did you mean one of these?<span class=\"ask-suggest\">" + btns + "</span>";
          }
          return FALLBACK;
        }

        // ---- Panel wiring ----
        var launcher = document.getElementById("askLauncher");
        var panel = document.getElementById("askPanel");
        var closeBtn = document.getElementById("askClose");
        var msgs = document.getElementById("askMsgs");
        var form = document.getElementById("askForm");
        var input = document.getElementById("askInput");
        if (!launcher || !panel || !msgs || !form || !input) return;
        var greeted = false;
        function addMsg(cls, html) {
          var d = document.createElement("div");
          d.className = "ask-msg " + cls;
          if (cls === "user") { d.textContent = html; } else { d.innerHTML = html; }
          msgs.appendChild(d);
          msgs.scrollTop = msgs.scrollHeight;
          return d;
        }
        function ask(text, topic) {
          var answer = topic ? ANSWERS[topic] : answerFor(text);
          if (!answer) answer = FALLBACK;
          if (topic === "prices") { CTX.kind = "price"; CTX.topic = "prices"; }
          if (topic === "included") { CTX.kind = "inc"; CTX.topic = "included"; }
          if (text) addMsg("user", text);
          addMsg("bot", answer);
        }
        // Did-you-mean chips are buttons inside a bot bubble: tapping
        // one asks its canonical question, like the visitor typed it.
        msgs.addEventListener("click", function (ev) {
          var t = ev.target;
          var b = t && t.closest ? t.closest(".ask-chip") : null;
          if (!b) return;
          var text = b.getAttribute("data-q");
          if (text) ask(text, null);
        });
        function setOpen(open) {
          var wasOpen = !panel.hidden;
          panel.hidden = !open;
          launcher.setAttribute("aria-expanded", open ? "true" : "false");
          // The chat is a popup too: while it is open, the page behind
          // stays locked, so scrolling the conversation (or hitting its
          // end) never drags the homepage with it.
          if (open && !wasOpen) lockPageScroll();
          if (!open && wasOpen) unlockPageScroll();
          if (open && !greeted) {
            greeted = true;
            addMsg("bot", "Hi I&rsquo;m Sourccey! What&rsquo;s up!?");
          }
          // No autofocus on open (owner order, 2026-10-23) — same rule as
          // the form sheets: the chat input is 16px, so a tap focuses it
          // without any iOS auto-zoom.
        }
        launcher.addEventListener("click", function () { setOpen(panel.hidden); });
        if (closeBtn) closeBtn.addEventListener("click", function () { setOpen(false); launcher.focus(); });
        document.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
          if (e.key === "Escape" && !panel.hidden) setOpen(false);
        });
        form.addEventListener("submit", function (ev) {
          ev.preventDefault();
          var text = input.value.trim();
          if (!text) return;
          input.value = "";
          ask(text, null);
        });
      })();
    </script>
    <script>
      // DESIGNER PASS #2 · ITEM 2 — tame the PURCHASE pill's pulse.
      // The pulse runs only from page load until the visitor's first
      // interaction — the first scroll OR the first tap/click anywhere
      // — then stops permanently for that view and the pill rests at
      // its steady master glow (.pulse-done, styled in the pass-2 CSS
      // block). One-time listeners; the pulse is box-shadow only, so
      // stopping it shifts nothing. A view restored from this tab's
      // saved view state counts as already-interacted: if the
      // view-state keeper's session entry describes a real earlier
      // view (scrolled, sections open, a sheet up),
      // the pulse never restarts on the restore.
      (function () {
        var pill = document.querySelector(".purchase-toggle");
        if (!pill) return;
        var restored = false;
        try {
          var raw = window.sessionStorage.getItem("sourccey-ck-view-v1");
          if (raw) {
            var st = JSON.parse(raw);
            restored = !!(
              (st && st.y > 0) ||
              (st && st.tg && Object.keys(st.tg).length > 0) ||
              (st && st.sheets && st.sheets.length > 0)
            );
          }
        } catch (e) {}
        if (restored) { pill.classList.add("pulse-done"); return; }
        var stop = function () { pill.classList.add("pulse-done"); };
        ["scroll", "pointerdown", "touchstart", "click", "keydown", "wheel"].forEach(function (ev) {
          window.addEventListener(ev, stop, { once: true, passive: true, capture: true });
        });
      })();
    </script>

      // MANUAL SHORTCUTS — each lesson's chip opens the manual at the
      // FIRST stage named in that lesson's own reference line, at that
      // stage's start page, confirmed against the manual index
      // (data:application/javascript;base64, — window.MANUAL_KB section starts):
      // Stage 0 p.3 · Stage 1 p.17 · Stage 2 p.22 · Stage 3 p.26 ·
      // Stage 4 p.42 · Stage 5 p.47 · Stage 6 p.95 · Stage 7 p.102 ·
      // Stage 8 p.113 · Stage 9 p.121 · Stage 10 p.130 · Stage 11 p.156.
      // Lessons 8–14 name no manual stage in their reference lines
      // (software / SDK lessons); their anchors stay on the manual
      // sections their work runs on — Stage 2 (the manual's software
      // preparation) for the software lessons, Stage 5's power system
      // for first power-up, and Stage 3's leader arms for the driving
      // and recording lessons.
      var MAN_ANCHOR = {
        1:  { s:0,  name:"Preparation & Body Sub Assemblies", p:3 },
        2:  { s:6,  name:"1st Level Body", p:95 },
        3:  { s:9,  name:"Linear Actuator", p:121 },
        4:  { s:10, name:"Robot Arms", p:130 },
        5:  { s:10, name:"Robot Arms", p:130 },

        7:  { s:5,  name:"Main Electrical", p:47 },

        13: { s:2,  name:"Motor ID & Software Preparation", p:22 },
        14: { s:10, name:"Robot Arms", p:130 }
      };
      function manChipHTML(L){
        var A = MAN_ANCHOR[L.n];
        if (!A) return '';
        return '<button type="button" class="nc-man-chip" data-man-page="' + A.p + '" aria-label="Open the Assembly Manual at Stage ' + A.s + ' — ' + A.name + ', page ' + A.p + '">📖 Manual · Stage ' + A.s + ' — ' + A.name + ' · p. ' + A.p + '<span class="nc-man-chip-go" aria-hidden="true">›</span></button>';
      }

      // MANUAL SHORTCUT — open the same Assembly Manual sheet the
      // MANUAL pill opens (through the pill's own data-open binding),
      // then land the book on the lesson's stage page: force-load that
      // page and scroll it to the top of the viewer, with the same
      // gold flash the manual's own citations use. The courses sheet
      // is never closed, so closing the manual returns to this exact
      // lesson — expanded state and scroll position untouched.
      function openManualAtPage(n){
        var pill = document.getElementById('ncManualPill');
        if (pill) pill.click();
        var wrap = document.getElementById('man-pages');
        var fig = document.getElementById('man-page-' + n);
        if (!wrap || !fig) return;
        if (wrap._manLoadPage) wrap._manLoadPage(n);
        requestAnimationFrame(function(){
          requestAnimationFrame(function(){
            wrap.scrollTop = Math.max(0, fig.offsetTop - wrap.offsetTop - 12);
            fig.classList.add('man-hit');
            setTimeout(function(){ fig.classList.remove('man-hit'); }, 2400);
          });
        });
      }
      // The Online Courses panel carries the identical lesson chips;
      // its delegated handler calls this same opener through here.
      window.__ncOpenManualAtPage = openManualAtPage;
